description: Our mission is to attend basketball tournaments with other law schools to maintain law student wellness and increase collaboration among neighboring law schools.

name: LAW - Black Law Students Association
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Law, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The Black Law Students Association is a professional, nationally-affiliated organization of Black law students dedicated to improving opportunities in legal education. The Cornell chapter actively involves itself in a wide variety of professional, academic, political, cultural, social, and educational activities. BLSA also sponsors various social activities with other law school and non-law school organizations.

name: LAW - Briggs Society of International Law
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The Briggs Society of International Law (Briggs) exists to further students' and society's understanding of international law and contemporary, international legal issues. The eponymous Professor, Herbert W. Briggs, was a distinguished lawyer, scholar, and educator in the international legal community. As an organization, we work to follow in the late Professor Briggs's footsteps. Briggs hosts guest speakers and introduces students to possible careers concerning international law.

name: LAW - Business Law Society
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The core mission of the Business Law Society is to foster an interdisciplinary education that equips students with comprehensive knowledge and skills to address the legal and business challenges encountered in private practice and corporate settings.

name: LAW - California Law Students Association
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Law, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: CALSA is a Cornell law student organization that provides support to students from California and those that want to work or establish a connection in California.  CALSA uses existing ties to California through alumni and other connections to provide substantive information regarding internships, fellowships, clerkships, Summer Associate positions, and the California state bar exam. CALSA is open to all individuals seeking a connection to California. Our purpose is to provide the necessary resources and framework to assist CALSA members achieve the necessary means to succeed in the legal profession.

name: LAW - Christian Legal Society
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The Christian Legal Society (CLS) is a national Christian fellowship organization committed to acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with God (Micah 6:8).  CLS inspires, encourages, and equips Christian lawyers and law students, both individually and in community, to proclaim, love and serve Jesus Christ through the study and practice of law, the provision of legal assistance to the poor and needy, and the defense of inalienable rights to life and religious freedom. The Cornell Law student chapter provides fellowship and mentorship opportunities to the Cornell law community.

name: LAW - Cornell Law Students Corporate Connect
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Law, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The purpose of Corporate Connect shall be to help law students succeed in their career goals as young professionals at Cornell Law School.

name: LAW - Cornell Middle Eastern and North African Law Students Association
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The Cornell Middle Eastern & North African Law Students Association (MENALSA) is an affinity group created to serve and bring together Middle Eastern and North African students at Cornell Law. MENALSA's mission is threefold: (1) to build a cultural community amongst Middle Eastern and North African law students and alumni, (2) to further the professional and academic development of its members, and (3) to organize around political and legal issues that impact Middle Eastern and North African communities.

name: LAW - Cuban American Bar Association at Cornell
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Law, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The mission of the Cuban American Bar Association (CABA), Cornell Law School, Student Chapter (hereinafter "Cornell CABA"), is to promote membership with the Cuban American Bar Association among current students at Cornell Law School. Cornell CABA membership is open to anyone who is interested in legal issues arising in the local community, and is determined to give back to the community using their legal skills. Our organization seeks members who share our vision of making a positive difference in the world. Cornell CABA will strive to foster the relationships between student members and the professional members of the Cuban American Bar Association, by hosting and promoting networking events and functions held by main chapter of the Cuban American Bar Association, while encouraging on-campus events with legal professionals. Cornell CABA's mission is to promote equality of our members; increase diversity in the judiciary and legal community; serve the public interest by increasing awareness to the study of jurisprudence; foster respect for the law; preserve high standards of integrity, honor, and professional courtesy among our peers; provide equal access to and adequate representation of all minorities before the courts; facilitate the administration of justice; build close relationships among our members; and support the indigent community through effective pro bono service projects in the community.

name: LAW - Environmental Law Society
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Sustainability/Environmental, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The Environmental Law Society (ELS) is an independent student organization at Cornell Law School designed to increase student exposure to the quickly-evolving practice of environmental law, as well as to appreciate the importance of environmental public interest work both domestically and abroad.

name: LAW - Federalist Society at Cornell
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Law, Political/Speech/Debate, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The Federalist Society is founded on the principles that the state exists to preserve freedom, that the separation of governmental powers is central to our Constitution, and that it is emphatically the province and duty of the judiciary to say what the law is, not what it should be.

name: LAW - First-Generation Student Association
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The mission of the organization is to: promote advocacy, community, empowerment, and identity exploration for all law students who identify with the first-generation and/or low-income student experience and supporters of these students. This group recognizes a wide range of first-generation students, including those who will be the first lawyers in their families, but prioritizes the needs of first-generation high school and college graduates who attended public primary and secondary schools and are from low-income backgrounds. Relying on the honor code, FGSA considers "low-income" to include students who receive little or no expected family contribution as part of the financial aid package, could not or cannot consistently rely on parents for financial support throughout higher education, or whose socioeconomic status have significantly limited their prior academic and social experiences.

name: LAW - If/When/How: Lawyering for Reproductive Justice
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Law, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The mission of If/When/How: Lawyering for Reproductive Justice shall be to develop a student community that works towards the realization of reproductive justice in all its dimensions. The organization will work towards ensuring an intersectional approach towards reproductive rights that empowers individuals to choose if, when, and how they would like to have children. Through advocacy and campaigning, the student community shall mobilize and advocate for reproductive justice that is free from coercion, discrimination, and violence. In doing so, LJR will also emphasize its focus on the intersection between reproductive justice and other issues including race, class, disability, sexual orientation, and gender identity.

name: LAW - Intellectual Property and Technology Students Association
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Law, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: IPTSA's purpose is to provide the law school community with outlets, both academic and social, to pursue interests in Intellectual Property, including Patent Law, Copyright Law, Trademark Law, and Technology Transfer Law, via specific events.

name: LAW - International Arbitration Society at Cornell
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Law, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: Cornell International Arbitration Society shall provide a forum for the scholarly analysis and discussion of international commercial and investment arbitration, their legal problems and developments.

name: LAW - International Law Students Association
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The organization aims to promote community, empowerment, and advocacy for all international students at Cornell Law School.  In particular, ILSA aims to address the needs of incoming international law students who are new to the United States.  ILSA harnesses the power of alumni and peer mentoring to build knowledge and skills that help new international law students navigate the profession of law.

name: LAW - Jewish Law Student Association
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The purpose of the Jewish Law Students Association (JLSA) is to maintain a Jewish presence at the school and represent all segments of the Jewish community. JLSA provides social, cultural, and religious activities for the entire community. In addition, JLSA seeks to augment awareness of legal and political issues of concern to Jews, as well as, awareness of the Jewish experience in the legal world. JLSA is affiliated with the National Law Student Network.

name: LAW - Korea Law and Culture Society
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The purpose of the Korea Law and Culture Society and Culture Society (KLCS) shall be to provide the resources, mentorship, and necessary help for all students who desire to practice law in Korea or more generally foster their connections to Korea both cultural and professional.

name: LAW - Latino American Law Student Association
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, PROF: Law, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The purpose of LALSA is to utilize the collective resources of the members to: (1) Articulate and promote the academic and professional needs and goals of Latino law students; (2) Foster and encourage professional competence; (3) Focus on the relationship of the Latino law student and attorney to the American legal structure; (4) Instill in the Latino law student and attorney a greater awareness of and commitment to the needs of the Latino community; (5) Influence the legal community to bring about meaningful change to meet the needs of the Latino community; (6) Preserve and promote awareness of Latino culture and unity among Latino groups; and (7) Do all things necessary and appropriate to accomplish these purposes.

name: LAW - Law and Political Economy Collective
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: To advance the practice and study of Law and Political Economy among law students.

name: LAW - Law School Soccer Club
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The purpose of the Law School Soccer Club is to organize soccer games for the physical and mental wellness for students in the Law School and other departments at Cornell University. Soccer is an amazing way for students to relieve stress, have fun, and meet new people from different departments on campus. The club also will help improve soccer abilities in a competitive, safe, and fun environment. The club welcomes both graduate and undergraduate students. We hope to see you on the field!

name: LAW - Lincoln Douglas Society Cornell Chapter
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The purpose of The Lincoln Douglas Society Cornell Chapter shall be to function as a debating society at Cornell Law School promoting civil discourse and free speech by hosting open debates on relevant topics.

name: LAW - Mock Trial
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Law, Political/Speech/Debate, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: To prepare Cornell Law students to be effective trial advocates at internal, regional, and national competitions and throughout their careers

name: LAW - Muslim Law Student Association
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: Our mission is to spread awareness of events in the Muslim world and to help foster a community of inclusiveness.

name: LAW - National Lawyers Guild
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Law, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The NLG is dedicated to the need for basic change in the structure of our political and economic system. NLG aims to bring together all those who recognize the importance of safeguarding and extending the rights of workers, women, LGBTQ people, people with disabilities and people of color, upon whom the welfare of the entire nation depends; who seek actively to eliminate racism; who work to maintain and protect our civil rights and liberties in the face of persistent attacks upon them; and who look upon the law as an instrument for the protection of the people, rather than for their repression.

name: LAW - Native American Law Student Association
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Law, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The purpose of the Cornell Law School NALSA shall be to: articulate and promote the professional needs and goals of Native Law Students and their allies; foster and encourage professional competence; focus upon the relationship of the Native American Law Student, the Native American Attorney and their allies to the American legal structure; instill in every attorney and Law Student a greater awareness and commitment to the needs of the Native American community; influence the legal community to bring about meaningful change to meet the needs of the Native American community; adopt and implement a policy of economic independence; encourage law students to pursue careers in the judiciary; and do all things necessary and appropriate to accomplish these purposes. However, this organization will not limit itself to this sole objective. We reserve the right to become involved in other objectives.

name: LAW - OutLaw
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The purpose of OutLaw is to provide programming on LGBTQ legal issues and advocacy and to serve as a welcoming community for LGBTQ law students.

name: LAW - Society of Wine and Jurisprudence
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Food/Drink, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: To educate members and the broader community about relevant (primarily legal) issues that impact the production, distribution, and consumption of wine. In keeping with that goal and our broader mission, we also seek to engage our members in professional development and etiquette.

name: LAW - South Asian Law Students Association
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The South Asian Law Students Association promotes education and leadership among South Asian law students and expands students' understanding and appreciation of South Asian political, legal and social issues.  SALSA hopes to provide a space for law students interested in the South Asian experience to gather, create support networks, and form a community.

name: LAW - Sports and Entertainment Law Society
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: SELS is the go-to student organization for all matters concerning sports and entertainment law.  We look to bring in guest speakers, engage in competitions, and generally network with those in the sports and entertainment law fields.  Sports and entertainment law spans arbitration, labor law, contracts, copyright application and infringement, and much more. This organization is a registered student organization of Cornell University.

name: LAW - Tax Law Association at Cornell
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: Promote the study of tax law

name: LAW - Veteran Student Association at Cornell Law
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Student Groups for Student Services, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: CLVA is an organization for law students with (1) current or prior military service, (2) an interest in law related to military affairs, veteran's affairs, and international law, and/or (3) an interest in a career as a JAG officer, Dept. of Veterans Affairs attorney, or other veteran-related law practice.

name: LAW - WOMEN OF COLOR COLLECTIVE
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: Women of Color Collective's (WOCC) purpose is to provide a supportive space for African-American, African, Afro-Caribbean, Asian, South Asian, Middle Eastern, Hispanic/Latina, Native American, Bi-racial, Multi-racial and other women students of color at Cornell Law School. Through cultural, social, professional, educational and community service programs, WOCC will advance the needs of women and students of color and enrich the educational and mentorship experience of women of color at Cornell Law School. In addition, WOCC's purpose is to address the unique challenges currently faced by women of color in the legal profession and enhance the knowledge of the wider Cornell Law School and Cornell University community of those challenges and ways in which we can redress those challenges.

name: LAW - Women's Law Coalition
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Law, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The Women's Law Coalition promotes women in the law through mentorship programs, speakers, networking events, and professional panels.

name: Mass Spectrometry Student Society at Cornell
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: The Mass Spectrometry Student Society at Cornell (MS3) brings together students interested in applying mass spectrometry to -omics and related research. Our mission is to foster a community for sharing knowledge, discussing innovative approaches, and exchanging practical experience in mass spectrometry. We also aim to introduce new students to the field through peer support, educational activities, and collaboration across departments.

name: Medieval Studies Graduate Association
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Student Groups for Student Services
description: The Medieval Studies Graduate Association is dedicated to being a forum for sustained discussion and debate within the student medievalist body on campus and to strengthening connectivity between these students. It aims to provide a platform for underrepresented groups and disciplines. It also provides an official channel for discussion with faculty, the MS Department, and the Graduate School. It was founded at a time when there was no such forum in existence. Its purpose is to encourage collaboration by Cornellians from across the spectrum of departments and programs on campus, so that they can get to know one another and exchange views in a relaxed and sociable atmosphere. We welcome any graduate student in any department whose research falls within the approximate time frame from the 5th c. to 15th c. CE, or anyone interested in decolonizing and/or abolishing the structures of their own fields of study. This association provides necessary professional and social activities that bring the medieval and the medievalist community together.

name: Medieval Studies Student Colloquium
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Student Groups for Student Services
description: The Medieval Studies Student Colloquium is a forum dedicated to showcasing the ideas and research of the medievalist community at Cornell. Now in its thirty-sixth year (academic year 2025-2026), MSSC is an annual one-day colloquium organized by the graduate students of the Medieval Studies Program. Each year, MSSC is an opportunity for all interested in the Middle Ages at Cornell—as well as visitors from other institutions—to share papers in a relaxed and friendly environment. In recent years, MSSC has also organized events leading up to the colloquium, including lectures and workshops led by invited scholars.

name: Nolan Research Student Association
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management, AFFILIATION: Nolan Hotel School
description: Transform critical thinking into promising research questions and encourage collaborations beyond the traditional boundary.

name: Operations Research Graduate Association
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Engineering
description: The purpose of ORGA shall be to unite all ORIE PhD students and create events and interaction within the department and broader community.

name: Pelvic Pain Association at Cornell
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The Pelvic Pain Association at Cornell (PPAC) promotes solidarity and activism around pelvic pain issues.  We are inclusive of many different conditions that may cause chronic pelvic pain, including PCOS, endometriosis, adenomyosis, vulvodynia, IBS, ovarian cysts, uterine fibroids, and many others, including undiagnosed conditions.  We are not a provider of health care advice or affiliated with any other pelvic pain organization.

name: Proyecto Palante
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Performing Arts
description: Our mission is to honor and share Latino culture with the Cornell community through diverse dance techniques, programming, and music.

name: Robotics Graduate Student Organization
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Engineering
description: The purpose of this organization is to foster fellowship between labs and members of the Cornell graduate student robotics community and beyond, independent of department affiliation.

name: Saudi Students Association
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The Saudi Student Association at Cornell (SaudiSA) celebrates and promotes the Saudi Arabian culture, history, and tradition throughout the Cornell and Ithaca community by organizing and hosting relevant events and activities. SaudiSA also gathers and represents all current and alumni Cornell Saudi students and addresses their needs and concerns.

name: Society for Buddhist Studies
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: Our mission is to promote the study of Buddhism at Cornell University.

name: Sri Lankan Association at Cornell University
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The Sri Lankan Association at Cornell University (SLACU) is dedicated to fostering a robust and inclusive network for the Sri Lankan community within Cornell. Our mission is to enrich the Cornell community through the promotion of Sri Lankan culture and heritage, while facilitating a seamless transition for incoming graduate students from Sri Lanka. We are committed to creating an inviting space that encourages cross-cultural engagement and understanding, thereby contributing to the vibrant diversity of the Cornell community.

name: Swing Syndicate at Cornell
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Performing Arts
description: The purpose of the organization is to teach and promote swing dance to Cornell University students and community members. The organization focuses on dances called swing dance—dances danced to swing jazz music—such as Lindy Hop, Charleston and Balboa swing dances.

name: Systems Engineering Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Engineering
description: The purpose of SysEGSA shall be to form and serve a community of graduate students with similar interests in interdisciplinary innovation, professional development, community outreach, and in creating a socially welcoming environment.

name: Taiwanese Student Association at Cornell
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: Cornell Taiwanese Student Association (CTSA) is a non-profit, not-religious and non-political group. Our major mission is to help Taiwanese Student adapt to life and academic studies in Cornell Community. Our group also works as a platform for Taiwanese student to build up connections among students and communities. We also welcome anyone who is interested in Taiwanese culture to join our activities and to learn more about this beautiful island.

name: The Sharing Bowl Club
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, Student Groups for Student Services
description: The Sharing Bowl Club at Cornell brings together graduate students and undergraduate researchers pursuing interdisciplinary studies and research. Unlike researchers in well-established fields with well-established norms, interdisciplinary researchers could struggle with the lack of sense of belonging while navigating norms, language, and expectations of diverse fields at the same time. We aim to create a welcoming environment where members can discuss not only their research but also the unique challenges and joys of being interdisciplinary. Our goal is to normalize the uncertainty, curiosity, and creativity that come with crossing disciplinary boundaries. Inspired by feminist consciousness-raising and mutual aid, the club values collective care, dialogue, and cultural exchange. We believe in supporting one another through shared experiences: meals, conversations, tending to plants, and exploring Ithaca and beyond.

name: Upcycled Food Club
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Food/Drink, Sustainability/Environmental
description: Our mission is to spread awareness of the upcycled food revolution (upcycled foods are foods made from products that would normally go to waste) as one of the top solutions to climate change through delicious and nutritious food, education, and networking.

name: Women in Healthcare Leadership
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare, AFFILIATION: Brooks School
description: Women in Healthcare Leadership is an independent, self-governing young professional organization at Cornell University which empowers women to pursue leadership roles and management positions within both private and public health care systems, hospital networks, and private firms by uniting professional development, personal growth, mentorship, and industry resources. The organization is also dedicated to the global elevation of women, in all industries, and serves to provide resources to those interested in professional development. We recognize the impact of uniting diverse thoughts and backgrounds to create a better health system for all. Focused on offering support to women who are building careers in the healthcare industry, WIHL facilitates networking opportunities with prospective employers and alumni, professional development programs, community service outreach projects, and hosts formal and informal activities to unite graduate and undergraduate students.

name: Women in Public Policy
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Political/Speech/Debate, AFFILIATION: Brooks School
description: Cornell Women in Public Policy (WIPP) graduate student organization was founded in 1994. Maintaining the historic mission of integrating women into public policy roles, WIPP's mission is also to facilitate the professional integration of people of all genders, races and ethnicities, abilities, sexual orientations, communities, and socioeconomic statuses into public policy roles. The organization promotes principles of equality, justice, and integrity in the public and private arenas while providing a support system and networking opportunities for its members. To this end, WIPP organizes discussions and generates public awareness about economic, social, political, and historical issues in relation to gender in the policy. WIPP fosters leadership and personal relationships through professional development, community outreach, and cultural exchange.

name: Women's Planning Forum
category: Grad/Professional General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: To celebrate women's contributions to the field of planning, provide a forum for discussion of gender issues in planning, and to promote gender equity in the classroom. Each year, we run a series of events on this theme, including dinners with guest speakers, monthly teas, and retreats, and general discussions. We also shed light on gender issues outside of planning, focusing on how women navigate space and build community together.

name: Access Johnson
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson School, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Access Johnson is the club for accessibility, accommodations, and advocacy at Johnson.

name: AEM Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Business and Management, AFFILIATION: Dyson School
description: AEM Graduate Student Association is a graduate student organization in the field of applied economics and management at Cornell University. The organization's purpose is to provide a framework for common activities of its members, to support interaction among its members on a regular basis, and to support graduate students in academic and other ways while studying at the Charles H. Dyson School of Applied Economics and Management.

name: Animal Science Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: The purpose of this organization is to promote stronger graduate student relations with peers and mentors within Animal Sciences and other disciplines.

name: Anthropology Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The purpose of Anthropology Graduate Student Association shall be to represent the interests of graduate students in the Anthropology PhD and CIAMS MA programs in relation to the Department, Graduate Field, and University, keep records of graduate student activities and concerns for future cohorts, and help foster community among graduate students.

name: Applied Physics Graduate Society
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Student Groups for Student Services
description: The purpose of the APGS is to facilitate communication among the applied physics graduate students as well as the broader Cornell community. Our goals include disseminating important information to graduate students and acting as a formal voice for graduate students within the workings of the department. Additionally, the APGS fosters community among physics graduate students by organizing social events and discussion forums. With a founding principle of “... any person ... any study,” Cornell is an equal opportunity employer and educator. For more information, visit hr.cornell.edu/eeo.

name: Apprenti of Prometheus (Ph.D. Student Association)
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson School, PROF: Business and Management
description: Over 2000 years ago, Prometheus stole fire from the gods and brought it to humanity in the form of technology, knowledge and civilization. Today, the Ph.D. students association of Johnson Graduate School of Management has the ambitious objective to facilitate the development of new knowledge in the fields of Accounting, Finance, Marketing, Management and Organisation, OTIM, and Strategy.  Our mission is to organize meetings among Ph.D. students of Johnson Graduate School of Management in order to provide networking opportunities and to facilitate the exchange of ideas.

name: Asian Affinity Business Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - International/Multicultural, AFFILIATION: Johnson School, Student Groups for Student Services
description: There is a growing need to create a stronger and more inclusive community for those of Asian heritage among prospective students, current students, alumni, partners, faculty, and staff at the SC Johnson School of Business. We hope to foster a community at Johnson that builds relationships among current Asian Affinity Business Association members, provides professional support and mentorship, and promotes greater awareness and allyship of the Asian heritage across the general Johnson community.

name: Associate Real Estate Council
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson School, PROF: Business and Management
description: AREC is Cornell's graduate student-run real estate organization. It is committed to enhancing Cornell's presence in the industry and providing its members with educational and career development opportunities. AREC membership should be viewed as a stepping stone to lifetime involvement in real estate as a Cornellian, including membership in the Cornell Real Estate Council.

name: Association of Cornell Women in Real Estate
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: The mission of the Association of Cornell Women in Real Estate (ACWIRE) is to promote the advancement of professional women in real estate, starting with current graduate and professional students at Cornell.

name: Association of Veterans
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson School, Student Groups for Student Services
description: To recruit high potential US and Non-US military veterans into the Johnson School, and assist with their success in transitioning to the classroom and into their desired career.

name: Astronomy Graduate Network
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Community Service
description: Host events and useful discussions for graduate astronomy students. Hold outreach events to increase public awareness of astronomy.

name: Big Red Brewing
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Food/Drink
description: The mission of Big Red Brewing is to bring awareness to the benefits of applying new technologies to a growing industry.

name: Biochemistry Molecular and Cell Biology Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Health/Wellbeing, PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: The BMCB Graduate Student Association (BMCB GSA) serves to connect graduate students in the Graduate Field of Biochemistry, Molecular, and Cell Biology and to facilitate discussion of research, outreach opportunities, professional development, and our graduate field.

name: Biogeochemistry Environmental Science and Sustainability Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Sustainability/Environmental
description: The purpose of the BESS GSA is to bring together graduate students from different Cornell departments who are interested in biogeochemistry, environmental sciences and sustainability. The GSA aims to facilitate networking, run workshops and events, share student research and involve faculty to foster interdisciplinary collaboration.

name: Biological & Environmental Engineering Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Student Groups for Student Services, Sustainability/Environmental
description: Our purpose is to provide social and professional events for the graduate students in the BEE department.

name: Biomedical & Biological Sciences
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: The purpose of the Biomedical Biological Sciences Graduate Student Society (BBSGSS) is to facilitate communication between the graduate students and the faculty in the Biomedical & Biological Sciences (BBS) program at Cornell.

name: Biomedical Engineering Society
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Student Groups for Student Services
description: The object of the chapter shall be to promote the profession of biomedical engineering through the organized effort of this group in study, research, and discussion of the fields of biomedical engineering and the dissemination of knowledge thereby gained. The chapter shall strive to provide an inclusive environment and encourage diversity within our organization and our community. The chapter shall promote membership in the BMES by acquainting the student body with the ideas, purposes, and objectives of BMES

name: Biomedical Engineering Women's Group
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Engineering
description: The purpose of the Biomedical Engineering Women's Group is to to support women in biomedical engineering within and beyond Cornell.

name: Biophysics Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: The Biophysics Graduate Student Association (Biophysics GSA) serves to connect graduate students in the Graduate Field of Biophysics and to facilitate discussion of research, outreach opportunities, professional development, and our graduate field.

name: Black Graduate Business Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson School, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, Student Groups for Student Services
description: The Black Graduate Business Association (BGBA) at Johnson is dedicated to the recruitment and support of students of African descent. Additionally, the organization is committed to the professional, academic, and social development of its membership. Members of the BGBA have the unique opportunity to initiate and execute key events in the Johnson community, interact with corporations on an individual basis, and coordinate with faculty,staff, alumni, and students in programs that shape our community.

name: Black Graduate Professional Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Community Service, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The Black Graduate and Professional Student Association (BGPSA) is a network that addresses the needs and concerns of graduate and professional students of African descent at Cornell University. BGPSA engages in social, academic, and cultural initiatives as determined by its voting membership, which is open to all graduate and professional students. BGPSA works closely with faculty and staff and is involved in issues that affect Ithaca's Black community. BGPSA will do all things necessary and appropriate to accomplish these purposes.

name: BR Tech Strategy
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson School, PROF: Business and Management, PROF: Engineering
description: At BR Tech Strategy, we envision creating a dynamic platform where MBA students collaborate with Cornell inventors and early-stage startups to unlock the commercial potential of innovative, university-generated technologies. Through strategic partnerships with Cornell’s engineering school, we aim to bridge the gap between academia and real-world business application, empowering MBA students to apply their core skills in meaningful, hands-on consulting projects. By mentoring engineering project teams and fostering entrepreneurial thinking, we strive to drive innovation and support the growth of breakthrough technologies.

name: Canadian Business Club
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - International/Multicultural, AFFILIATION: Johnson School, PROF: Business and Management
description: We are an organization representing Canadians interested in careers in business, and allow them to network and connect with one another.

name: CEMS Club USA
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - International/Multicultural, Active/Recreational: Outdoor Experience, AFFILIATION: Dyson School
description: CEMS is a global alliance of leading business schools and corporate partners that offer a joint master's program in Management. The CEMS Club is dedicated to bringing closer together the CEMS community and offering CEMS students the opportunity to build life-long friendships through fun activities as well as enhancing their skillset for a global career.

name: Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering Graduate Women's Group
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Community Service, PROF: Engineering
description: The purpose of CBEWomen shall be 1) to focus on issues pertinent to affiliates of the School of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering, and 2) to encourage students (such as but not limited to girls) to enter engineering through outreach.

name: Chemical Engineering Graduate Student Association (ChEGSA)
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Community Service, Student Groups for Student Services
description: The mission of Chemical Engineering Graduate Student Association (ChEGSA) is to bring together the graduate students and postdocs of the R.F Smith School of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering (CBE), through both professional and social events. Through these events, we strive to improve the well-being, connections, and skills of our members so that they can strive for greatness while they are here at Cornell and beyond graduation.

name: Civil and Environmental Engineering Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Student Groups for Student Services
description: The Civil and Environmental Engineering Graduate Student Association (CEE GSA) organizes social and cultural events for graduate students as well as promotes professional activities. The CEE GSA strives to foster communication among graduate students from different concentrations, staff and faculty, and to provide a forum for the free exchange of ideas.

name: Communication Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Student Groups for Student Services
description: We are the official club organization for graduate students in the Department of Communication. Our duty is foster a sense of community within the department. We start by making sure that the graduate students have opportunities to relax, have fun, and socialize throughout the year. Additionally, we support department efforts to further their professional development through such events as workshops and roundtable discussions.

name: Computational Biology Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: The purpose of the CBGSA is to build a community for the Computational Biology students and support them for success in graduate school and their future careers.

name: Cornell Energy Club
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson School, Sustainability/Environmental
description: The Cornell Energy Club is a student-led club that connects Cornell graduate students pursuing careers in the energy industry. We are united in our motivation to drive change and tackle the most challenging problems facing the energy industry.

name: Cornell Public Affairs Student Society
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, Student Groups for Student Services, AFFILIATION: Brooks School
description: The Cornell Public Affairs Society (CPAS) is the official student-led organization representing the public policy student community at the Cornell Jeb E. Brooks School of Public Policy. Our mission is to foster a collaborative, inclusive, and engaged student community that supports academic success, professional development, public service values, and meaningful peer connections.

name: Cornell School of Integrated Plant Sciences Graduate Student Council Club
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Departmental, PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: The Graduate Student Council (GSC) is a representative body of graduate students across the five sections within SIPS: Horticulture, Plant Breeding and Genetics, Plant Biology, Soil and Crop Sciences, and Plant Pathology and Plant-Microbe Biology. We host SIPS-wide social and educational events.  Representing the collective voice of SIPS graduate students, we to discuss current policies, action items, or concerns that arise within the SIPS community.

name: Cornell University Healthy Futures Graduate Chapter
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Health/Wellbeing, PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: Cornell University Healthy Futures: Graduate Chapter (CUHFG) is the graduate division of the first academic institute (Cornell Institute for Healthy Futures) in the country to combine hospitality, environmental design, and health policy and management into a broad-based platform to improve service in healthcare, wellness, and senior living.

name: Corporate Leadership Club
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson School, PROF: Business and Management
description: The Corporate Leadership Club is a valuable resource for Johnson MBA students pursuing careers in Marketing, General Management, and Corporate Finance. CLC's goal is to equip its members with the skill set to become better educated and prepared for corporate internship and full time recruiting. Through active involvement from all members, CLC maintains high visibility at Johnson, as well as with corporations, recruiters, alumni, and related MBA communities. Most importantly, CLC provides structure, support, and encouragement, both personally and professionally, to accelerate development of all its members.

name: Department of Natural Resources Graduate Student Assembly
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare, Sustainability/Environmental
description: The purpose of the Cornell University Department of Natural Resources Graduate Student Association is to act as a liaison between graduate students and faculty, foster academic interaction among graduate students, advocate for and support graduate students, and support important social functions throughout the academic year.

name: Ecology and Evolutionary Biology Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: The EEB GSA is maintained by graduate students in the department to represent their interests and contribute to the community.

name: Electron Devices Society
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Engineering, Student Groups for Student Services
description: The primary purpose of the society is to meet every week to listen to a colleague explain his or her research. This creates valuable opportunities for researchers to practice giving technical presentations and to generate new research collaborations. Additional guest speakers from inside or outside Cornell may be invited to speak on technical or non-technical topics of interest to the EDS community. Occasional social events may be organized through EDS but the primary purpose is to generate scholarly discussion of science and engineering.

name: ENG - Cornell Electronic Circuits Society
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Engineering
description: The purpose of Cornell Electronic Circuits Society is to provide the electrical and computer engineering department as well as the greater engineering community at Cornell with opportunities to interact with members of the analog, digital, radio frequency integrated circuits and power electronics communities and expose student and faculty to current research trends in those areas. The society can enhance student interaction with the field and cultivate a welcoming and inspiring culture around electronic circuits at Cornell.

name: Engineers’ MBA Club at Cornell
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Business and Management, PROF: Engineering, PROF: Science/Healthcare, PROF: Software/Coding/Programming, Student Groups for Student Services
description: The Cornell Engineering Leadership Club (CELC) empowers technical professionals to pivot into strategic business leadership roles. We cultivate strategic thinking, business acumen, leadership identity, and global innovation skills, preparing our members to drive transformational impact at the intersection of engineering and business.

name: English Graduate Student Organization
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Food/Drink, PROF: Education/Human Services
description: EGSO fosters PhD and MFA student life and culture by striving to create community, to plan and implement programming for academic and professional development, and to establish unity and cohesion among the English Department's graduate student body.

name: ETA Club at Cornell
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson School, PROF: Business and Management
description: To inform about the search fund asset class, to serve as a meeting platform for Cornellians interested in entrepreneurship through acquisition (ETA), and to connect current students, alumni, the investor community, and other interested parties

name: European Club
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - International/Multicultural, AFFILIATION: Johnson School
description: The European Club supports European Students at the Johnson School and students of all nationalities with an interest in Europe through Campus Activities and Career Support.

name: Experimental Sound Series at Cornell
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Performing Arts
description: The Experimental Sound Series at Cornell presents an annual concert series, featuring the music of Cornell graduate composers. The series, typically consisting of three events a year, is an integral component of the composers' experience at Cornell and provides a critical environment for collaborations with professional musicians both inside and outside of Ithaca. Since its inception, the ESSC has been dedicated its efforts to showcasing world premieres by Cornell's emerging composers.

name: Family Business Club
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson School, PROF: Business and Management
description: The Johnson Family Business Club serves as a forum for students with an interest in privately held corporations. This club works with local family businesses to generate meaningful connections and opportunities to prepare for working within, leading, and passing on a family-owned enterprise over the course of time. This club is for any student who has a business in their family, regardless of the size, industry, or the student's personal experience within it. Additionally, students planning to start a family business in the future or who are interested in working for family businesses in consulting, asset management, or general management are welcome to join. The club focuses on three primary pillars: Networking, Education, and Recruiting. Club activities include educational forums with current members, guest speakers from alumni and prominent business leaders, field trips for on-site exposure to various corporations, advisory board position opportunities, networking events with other top business schools, and social outings. Club members will examine current research, in partnership with the school's Smith Family Business Initiative, detailing the competitive advantages (and challenges) of family-controlled businesses. Members will also have the opportunity to listen to leaders of business-owning families while sharing their personal experiences. Please feel free to reach out directly to our officers for more information.

name: Field of Microbiology Students
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare, Student Groups for Student Services
description: We are a group for graduate students in the Field of Microbiology or interested in microbiology. We aim to organize social events, informative workshops, and increase a sense of community amongst graduate students.

name: Food Science Graduate Student Organization
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Food/Drink, Student Groups for Student Services
description: The mission of this organization is to facilitate relationships among graduate students within the Food Science department. It is the aim of the FSGSO to provide events and encourage discussions among students that will enhance the experience of the students throughout their graduate studies

name: Genetics Genomics & Development Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Student Groups for Student Services
description: GGD GSA serves to enrich the academic and social environment for the graduate students in the Field of Genetics, Genomics, and Development in the department of Molecular Biology and Genetics.

name: Graduate Arab League
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - International/Multicultural
description: The purpose of GAL shall be to foster community building among Arab students, and to address the social, academic, and cultural needs and concerns of graduate and professional students of the Arab community at Cornell University. We understand the term 'Arab' as an umbrella term to include any member of the Cornell graduate and professional community who identifies with Arab culture, widely defined, and not as Arab. GAL is open to graduate and professional students from all backgrounds who support this mission.

name: Graduate League of Women in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Engineering
description: GLOW provides networking, service, and outreach opportunities with the goal of strengthening and supporting the community of women and gender minority graduate students in the Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering department at Cornell.

name: Graduate Researchers in Media and Performing Arts (GRMPA formerly AGiT)
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Performing Arts
description: GRMPA advocates the needs and coordinates the voices of graduate students within the field of Performing and Media Arts (PMA); provides a forum for those students that actively seeks to connect academic work with creative practice; and facilitates an ongoing conversation within PMA and across the Cornell campus about our own current work, new ideas, and movements in performance and media studies at large.

name: Graduate Society of Women Engineers
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Engineering
description: Cornell's Grad SWE provides a welcoming environment for students to develop professional skills, network with peers, and give back to the community.

name: Graduate Student Association for Economics
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Business and Management, Student Groups for Student Services
description: GSAFE is the Graduate Student Association for Economics at Cornell University. GSAFE organizes opportunities for economics graduate students to present research, represents the interests of students to the faculty, and organizes social events for graduate students and faculty in the field.

name: Graduate Student School Outreach Program
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Community Service
description: GRASSHOPR is a graduate student-led outreach organization that aims to enrich the curricula of local K-12 students and better connect Cornell University graduate students to the Tompkins County and surrounding communities.

name: Graduate students in Public Health
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: Our mission is to help Cornell students build careers in the public health and healthcare industries. We aim to facilitate networking opportunities with prospective employers, professional development programs, community service involvement, and both formal and informal social activities, with the vision of connecting Cornell MPH students with great resources, like minded individuals, and planting the seeds for a strong alumni network.

name: Graduate Students in Public Policy
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Education/Human Services, Student Groups for Student Services, AFFILIATION: Brooks School
description: GSPP aims to provide resources for graduate students in order to facilitate research, make connections with others in the field of public policy, and grow professionally. This is accomplished through several different programs. First, GSPP hosts regular seminars that provide students an opportunity to present and gather feedback on their emerging research to fellow students and faculty. Second, GSPP holds additional meetings and events on topics related to professional development and the job market (ie. practice presentations, networking events, workshops). GSPP also holds social events throughout the year to facilitate camaraderie among graduate students and to serve as a support system during graduate school. We additionally facilitate and monitor the mentor - mentee student match program which pairs incoming first year students with upper year students who provide support and guidence during the first year.

name: Graduate Women in Science
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: We are committed to improving the culture of the sciences at Cornell and in Ithaca with a combination of outreach, teaching, and advocacy. We uphold that improving the scientific culture to help women and gender minorities thrive in the sciences requires improving the working conditions for everyone in our community, especially marginalized groups. As such, we are committed to building unity with everyone on the Cornell campus who are committed to improving the culture of the academy.

name: Greater China Business Club
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - International/Multicultural, AFFILIATION: Johnson School
description: The Greater China Business Club (GCBC) at Johnson is a student organization that brings together members in the Cornell Johnson community sharing or interested in Chinese culture. Johnson GCBC is committed to encouraging culture sharing, supporting its members to navigate the MBA program, and providing a networking platform.

name: High Tech Club
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson School, PROF: Business and Management
description: Objectives: -Educate members on trends in the technology industry -Provide an understanding of the roles (and their respective demands) available to MBAs -Provide opportunities to connect with and learn from representatives and alumni working with both established firms and startups -Provide training for recruiting in the technology industry

name: Hindu Business Society
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Spiritual/Religious, AFFILIATION: Johnson School, AFFILIATION: Johnson College of Business
description: The purpose of Hindu Business Society shall be to create a safe space for Hindu students of the SC Johnson College of Business at Cornell University where members can embrace and express their Hindu identity, learn about the Hindu religion and Hindu culture, share their life experiences, and apply learnings in their personal and professional lives. The goals of this organization are to enable a better understanding of and solidarity for the Hindu religion, Hindu culture, and Hindu identity among both the Hindu students in the SC Johnson College of Business and the wider student community, including students of other faiths and identities.

name: Hispanic American Business Leaders Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - International/Multicultural, AFFILIATION: Johnson School
description: To Hispanic American MBA students at Johnson, HABLA is the organization that helps recruit high potential Hispanic candidates and corporate sponsorship, supports our 1st and 2nd year students with mentoring, leadership, speaker events, and empowers Hispanic students through leadership training to develop into thoughtful leaders that will make positive changes in their communities.

name: History of Architecture and Urbanism Society
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Publication/Media, AFFILIATION: College of Architecture Art and Planning
description: The History of Architecture and Urbanism Society (HAUS) is to organize conferences, lecture series, and student forums to support Ph.D. students and candidates in the HAUD program, as well as the broader graduate & AAP community, with research methodology challenges and various aspects of professionalization.

name: History of Art and Visual Studies Association HAVSA
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Departmental
description: The purpose of History of Art and Visual Studies Association shall be to provide graduate students enrolled in Cornell’s department of History of Art & Visual Studies PhD program with a forum for discussing department business, upcoming events, and scholarly interests relating to the field of art and visual studies. This organization will also provide an opportunity for graduate students in the department to organize events and collaborate on papers, exhibitions, and conference papers/panels.

name: Hospitality Business Club
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Food/Drink, AFFILIATION: Johnson School, PROF: Business and Management
description: To facilitate career development opportunities, enhance industry knowledge, and encourage camaraderie among hospitality industry-focused Johnson students, alumni, and the Cornell community.

name: Human Capital Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson School, PROF: Business and Management
description: The Human Capital Association provides a forum for students, faculty and corporate executives to explore the various dimensions of human resource issues prevalent in global business. HCA aims to be a provider of educational and professional development with compelling speakers, workshops and symposiums. HCA promotes collaboration with the Center for Advanced Human Resource Studies (CAHRS), and the Society of Human Resource Management (SHRM) at the ILR School, as well as the Consulting Club and the Center for Leadership at Johnson. The group's values are respect, inclusiveness, passion, integrity and egalitarianism.

name: Human Centered Design Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - International/Multicultural
description: The purpose of this organization is to foster community among graduate DEA students and to set up events which would be beneficial academically and professionally.

name: ILR Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Student Groups for Student Services
description: The ILR Graduate Student Association at Cornell University’s School of Industrial and Labor Relations (ILR GSA) is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive environment for ILR graduate students while aligning with the overarching missions of ILR and Cornell University. As members of the 2024 GSA board, we are committed to building our community through student advocacy, transparent communication, and opportunities to form meaningful connections within the ILR graduate community.

name: ILR International Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - International/Multicultural, Student Groups for Student Services, AFFILIATION: ILR
description: The ILR IGSA is instituted to contribute to developmental needs of the international community of graduate students at the ILR School.

name: Indigenous Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Student Groups for Student Services
description: The purpose of the Indigenous Graduate Student Association shall be to foster community building among Indigenous graduate and professional students and allies. Further, the organization seeks to enhance personal, academic, and professional growth and development in a stable, community-based, peaceful environment, and to serve as a conduit for graduate and professional student issues and concerns, contributing to improving the experience of Indigenous students in graduate and professional education. The Indigenous Graduate Student Association is open to all graduate and professional students who support this mission.

name: Information Science Graduate Student Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Engineering, Student Groups for Student Services
description: The ISGSA promotes professionalization and socialization for graduate students in the department of Information Science.

name: International Graduate and Professional Students Organization
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Student Groups for Student Services
description: The mission of International Graduate and Professional Students is to bring together international graduate and professional students of Cornell University in a community where they can connect, belong, and thrive.

name: International Planning Student Organization
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - International/Multicultural, Student Groups for Student Services
description: International Planning Students Organization (IPSO) exists to build relationships with international development students in other departments of Cornell University, as well as other universities; to provide a forum for undergraduate and graduate students in their academic, research, and professional pursuits so they may have a better opportunity to link planning theory and practice; to reinforce cohesiveness within the International Studies in Planning (ISP) concentration within the department of City and Regional Planning; and to build ties and facilitate discussion between students and international planning practitioners.

name: Investment Management Club
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson School, PROF: Business and Management
description: The Investment Management Club (IMC) aims to help Johnson students who are interested in pursuing a career in investment management (buy-side, sell-side, private wealth management) and related fields recruit for internship and full-time roles through coordinated efforts with the CMC, CWGs, and weekly meetings organized to provide skill-based programming.

name: Jewish Business Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Spiritual/Religious, AFFILIATION: Johnson School, Student Groups for Student Services
description: The purpose of the Jewish Club shall be to host several social activities throughout the year to discuss the role of Judaism and its coexistence in today's business world. Events include dinners, cocktail hours, and guest speakers. It is a great networking opportunity with guest speakers, faculty members and your peers.

name: Johnson Africa Business Society
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - International/Multicultural, AFFILIATION: Johnson School
description: The Johnson Africa Business Society (JABS) is an organization that serves as a professional and cultural incubator for Cornellians who have a strong interest in business opportunities in Africa.

name: Johnson Christian Fellowship
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Spiritual/Religious, AFFILIATION: Johnson School
description: The purpose of the Johnson Christian Fellowship is to honor and glorify Jesus Christ, and to love and support each other and our Johnson classmates spiritually, socially, and emotionally.

name: Johnson Consulting Club
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson School, PROF: Business and Management
description: The Consulting Club is a student-run organization, with one of our consultants in residence as an advisor. It is one of the largest professional clubs at Johnson. The Club's mission is twofold: to assist our members in pursuing careers in consulting and to develop and nurture relationships with top consulting firms.

name: Johnson Food and Agriculture Club
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Food/Drink, AFFILIATION: Johnson School
description: Johnson Food, Beverage, and Agribusiness Club provides a space to educate the Johnson community on trends in the food, beverage, and agriculture industries. The club organizes cross-cultural and educational events to share the importance of food, beverage, and agriculture is for society and culture. JFBA is open to Johnson students and the Cornell graduate community.

name: Johnson Healthcare Club
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Health/Wellbeing, AFFILIATION: Johnson School, PROF: Business and Management
description: The JHC's mission is to provide a forum for interested students to learn about the healthcare industry and various career opportunities at related companies. The organization also works as a vehicle to educate and equip its members on best practices to recruit and land the internship and full-time career that is desired. The JHC develops new relationships and strengthens existing interactions with companies and recruiters in the effort to make Johnson a leading recruiting ground for healthcare companies of every type.

name: Johnson Japan Club
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - International/Multicultural, AFFILIATION: Johnson School
description: JJC strives to develop an open network to help deepen the understanding of the Japanese economy, business, culture, job market, language, and genuine cuisine. Members benefit by participating in presentations, cultural events, and job search sessions. Come along to explore with us.

name: Johnson MBA Student Council
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson School, Student Groups for Student Services
description: The MBA Student Council proactively works to improve the Johnson School by providing direction and implementing change. The committee consists of 1b elected students. The SC seeks input from students, faculty and staff on both strategic and tactical issues facing the school, focusing on strategic issues. Strategic areas range from alumni development to branding of the school to long term planning. Tactical areas range from curriculum requirements to food service to social events. The SC meets weekly with deans and other key faculty and staff members.

name: Johnson MPS Student Council
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson School, PROF: Business and Management
description: To build lifelong relationships within the MPS programs, to help MPS students improve professional networks and to improve alumni relations

name: Johnson Out for Business
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson School, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Out for Business Mission Statement: Out For Business (O4B) is the business club for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, and queer (LGBTQ+) Cornell Johnson students, their partners, and active allies. As future business leaders, we are committed to building a safe and welcoming environment for all students to be their full authentic selves. We strive to promote equality, diversity, and acceptance through education, advocacy, and social events. Our goal is to empower and support LGBTQ+ students in their personal and professional growth, and to foster an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and celebrated.

name: Johnson Southeast Asian Club
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - International/Multicultural, AFFILIATION: Johnson School, PROF: Business and Management
description: SEAC aims to celebrate the cultures of countries across Southeast Asian region (Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, Laos, Cambodia, Myanmar/Burma, and Brunei). We do that through community events and career support.

name: JUGATAE
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The mission of the organization is to provide a forum for addressing the needs of students in Entomology and to organize a seminar program in Entomology and allied fields, with the purpose of promoting interest and disseminating information therein.

name: Korean Business Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - International/Multicultural, AFFILIATION: Johnson School
description: 1) Strengthen Cornell Johnson MBA presence in Korean MBA society 2) Increase awareness and understanding of Korean culture throughout the Johnson community 3) Strengthen the Johnson School brand in Korea 4) Foster and maintain a network of Johnson School alumni throughout Korea

name: Latin American Business Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - International/Multicultural, AFFILIATION: Johnson School
description: The combined countries of the Latin American region have a population of more than 585 million people and an aggregate GDP of more than $5.5 trillion USD, representing more than 7% of the world's economy. The Latin American Business Association is the official organization for Latin American students studying at Johnson.

name: LAW - Association of Law & Economics at Cornell
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Law, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: Promote the study of law and economics; hold various speaker events and social programs open to the Cornell community.

name: LAW - Cornell JSD Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Law, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The purpose of CJSDA shall be to contribute to the overall success and well being of JSD students and graduates.

name: LAW - Cornell Law Review
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Publication/Media, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The Cornell Law Review publishes seven print issues of legal scholarship, as well as multiple online issues, each year.  The purpose of the Law Review is to advance legal scholarship and provide student editors with an opportunity to hone their legal writing skills, critically engage with legal scholarship, and take part in organizing and running a complex organization.

name: LAW - Cornell Law Students Association
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - PROF: Law, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: CLSA promotes the general welfare of Cornell Law School Students as the student government and student bar association of Cornell Law School. CLSA organizes social events to which all Cornell Law School students are invited.  CLSA also allocates funding to other Cornell Law School student groups.

name: LAW - International Law Journal at Cornell
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Publication/Media, PROF: Law, AFFILIATION: Law School
description: Founded in 1967, the Cornell International Law Journal (ILJ) is one of the oldest and most prominent international law journals in the United States. Four times a year, the Journal publishes scholarship that reflects the sweeping changes that are taking place in public and private international law. Each issue features articles by legal scholars, practitioners, and participants in international politics, as well as student-written notes.

name: LAW - Journal of Law and Public Policy
category: Grad/Professional University Student Organization (USO) - Publication/Media, PROF: Law, AFFILIATION: Law School
