name: International Affairs Society at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The Cornell International Affairs Society (CIAS) is Cornell's primary international relations club and official Model United Nations team. Its mission is to cultivate within students an enhanced understanding of international affairs while developing essential skills in public speaking, leadership, rhetoric and diplomacy.

name: International Business Association at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: The purpose of the International Business Association at Cornell shall be to promote an awareness of global business, foster a network of those with a common interest in international business, and provide support to those in the Cornell University community who are exploring international careers.

name: International Interior Design Association Cornell Campus Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Student Groups for Student Services
description: The purpose of IIDA Cornell University Campus Center shall be to serve as a pre-professional, event-based organization for students interested in careers in commercial interior design and architecture. In alignment with IIDA’s mission to provide meaningful resources to designers, we aim to foster a community that helps students advance their profession and connect education with practice.

name: Investment Banking Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: The Cornell Investment Banking Club (CIBC) is a student-run club at Cornell University with a core focus on preparing members to secure jobs within the financial industry, with a specific focus on recruitment in investment banking, through leadership opportunities, industry exposure and education.

name: Italian Society at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: We are the Italian community at Cornell. We engage with the larger community through a variety of activities, from social to professional.

name: Jamaican Students' Association at Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The Jamaican Students’ Association at Cornell University aims to foster a vibrant and inclusive community that celebrates the rich cultural heritage of Jamaica. For students from Jamaica and those with an interest in Jamaican culture, we strive to establish a welcoming and empowering environment. We will work to foster unity, diversity, and awareness on campus through cultural events, educational programs, and community outreach. Our organisation is dedicated to providing its members a platform for academic achievement, personal development, and cross-cultural communication while also making sure that each member has a sense of pride in their Jamaican background.  Our shared goal is to have a positive impact on our university community's diverse population.

name: Japan US Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: JUSA strives to: 1. Provide information regarding the Japanese culture and Japan - United States relations to the general populace 2. Promote interaction amongst Cornell students of all background through the promotion of the aforementioned topics 3. Offer support and resources for the Japanese, Japanese - American, and Japanese interest community at Cornell University

name: Jewish Voices for Peace at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Jewish Voice for Peace is the largest progressive Jewish anti-Zionist organization in the world. We’re organizing a grassroots, multiracial, cross-class, intergenerational movement of U.S. Jews into solidarity with the Palestinian freedom struggle, guided by a vision of justice, equality, and dignity for all people.

name: Judo Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: We exist to promote the Japanese martial art of judo through organized practices. We meet regularly so that our members can improve their skills, have fun, and eventually compete should they wish!

name: Juggling Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts, Visual Arts
description: To provide a forum for those interested in juggling and other circus arts.

name: Kali Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: The purpose of the Cornell Kali Club shall be to spread cultural awareness and cultivate physical and mental strength through weekly trainings of kKali, Filipino Martial Arts, at Cornell University. There is already a PE course on campus and many students are looking to supplement their regular classes with more training and also to invite others not enrolled in the class to join, train together and learn more about Filipino martial culture.

name: Kappa Alpha Pi Pre-Law Fraternity
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: Professional Fraternity (PFC), PROF: Law
description: Dedicated to providing interested students information about the law school application process, law school, and the legal profession, Kappa Alpha Pi aims to facilitate interaction between brothers, individuals within the law profession, and the community as a whole. Kappa Alpha Pi pursues these goals by providing the membership with the opportunity to participate in events focused on law and service designed to help the community of law.  KAPi also provide its members access to people in the area of law. Our fraternity is designed to educate about the field of law, but also strives to provide the most essential professional skills for its members.  Programming ranges from development of pre-professional skills to preparation for the Law School Admission Test (LSAT).  Brothers also participate in service and social events to foster friendship and camaraderie within the fraternity.  Big-Little pairings and "families" within KAPi help strengthen the bonds of fraternalism that transcends normal friendships.  The relationships that begin in the fraternity continue on throughout ones life. The official purpose of Kappa Alpha Pi shall be to form a strong bond uniting students and teachers of the law with members of the Bench and Bar in the fraternal fellowship designed to advance ideals of liberty and equal justice under law; to inspire the virtues of compassion and courage; to foster integrity and professional competence; to promote the welfare of its members; and to encourage their moral, intellectual, and cultural advancement; so that each member may enjoy a lifetime of honorable professional and public service.

name: Kappa Theta Pi Cornell Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: Professional Fraternity (PFC), PROF: Business and Management, PROF: Software/Coding/Programming
description: Build an active community of students with a shared interest in technology.

name: Karate Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: To help the Cornell Community develop its karate skills in a safe and fun environment.

name: Kashmiri Cultural Alliance
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The purpose of Kashmiri Cultural Alliance shall be to inform and educate students at Cornell about the social, historical, and political cultural of the areas now comprised of Azad Jammu & Kashmir, Gilgit-Baltistan, Jammu, Kashmir Valley, and Ladakh and how it intersects with broader political movements, religious philosophies, and analyze the historical impacts of individuals from aforementioned areas.

name: Kazakh Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: Our mission for the Kazakh club is to create a welcoming environment in which we can celebrate and share Kazakh culture. We strive to help Kazakh students feel more at home while studying abroad at Cornell, and also teach students of other cultures about our country. Through the club, we hope to create a close-knit community of students who are passionate about Kazakh culture and traditions.

name: Kedma
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: Kedma is the Orthodox organization at Cornell that provides for the religious and social needs of Orthodox Jews. Kedma is dedicated to upholding Orthodox values and maintaining a comfortable atmosphere for Orthodox students. By working with other student organizations, Kedma provides focused, well resourced programs and events for Orthodox students, as well as for the Cornell community at large. Kedma oversees the Orthodox prayer services held three times a day on campus. Kedma also maintains the Eruv at Cornell, which allows Jewish students on campus to carry on the Sabbath.

name: Kehilat Shevach: Cornell's Traditional Egalitarian Community
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: Shevach is Cornell's Traditional-Egalitarian (Conservative) minyan. We provide a community for students seeking a traditional Jewish prayer space that allows for egalitarian participation. We meet for traditional Shabbat services every Friday evening. We also hold periodic Shabbat morning services, programming for major Jewish holidays, and social events.

name: Kendo Club at Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: The purpose of the Kendo Club at Cornell University shall be to provide a space and environment for students interested in the Japanese martial art of Kendo, and to practice, compete, and improve together.

name: Kentucky Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Food/Drink, Performing Arts
description: The purpose of the Kentucky Club at Cornell shall be to build community around Kentucky cuisine, history, events, and culture. This club shall not limit membership to Kentucky residents, but instead will encourage all to join to learn more about the state of Kentucky.

name: Key Elements
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: The Key Elements take a cappella to new heights at Cornell University by bringing their unique energy and excitement to every performance. As a co-ed a cappella group, we perform innovative arrangements of songs from the classic rock genre along with other contemporary popular music that cannot be mimicked. We strive to not only provide Cornell with awe-inspiring music and concerts, but to also offer an opportunity for students of any background to pursue their musical passions, while creating lifelong friendships along the way.

name: Khiladi at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Performing Arts
description: The purpose of Khiladi at Cornell shall be to foster cultural expression, creativity, and community through South Asian fusion dance. The organization shall promote diversity and cultural appreciation within the Cornell community and beyond by engaging in performances, competitions, and events that integrate Indian and Western dance styles.

name: Kidney Disease Screening and Awareness Program
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: The Kidney Disease Screening and Awareness Program (KDSAP) is a student-run organization that provides free kidney health screenings and health education to underserved communities. Students are working under the supervision of Adult expertise providing supervision of students who will provide educational materials We provide programs geared towards improving the health of underserved populations.

name: Kiteboarding Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Active/Recreational: Outdoor Experience
description: To promote kiteboarding in a safe and affordable manner, while protecting the natural environment and advocating for positive social change.  We aim to make kiting accessible to the Cornell Community.

name: Klezmer Ensemble at Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: Weekly rehearsals in Lincoln 124 on Tuesdays from 7pm-9pm The purpose of CUKE is to provide a musical, nondenominational, informal setting for students and community members of all backgrounds to learn about Jewish culture and play Klezmer music.

name: Knit With Care
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Health/Wellbeing
description: The purpose of this organization is to teach people how to knit and crochet and to promote joy through fiber arts. Additionally, this club serves to further support Cornell's community of crafters.

name: Korean American Students Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Student Groups for Student Services
description: Our mission is to represent the Korean American community of Cornell University, and share and celebrate Korean and Korean American culture.

name: Korean Catholic Community at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Spiritual/Religious
description: The purpose of 4C shall be to provide a ground for Koreans or people of Korean descents who believe in Roman Catholicism to carry out and continue the work of Jesus Christ on Earth through fellowships and different activities.

name: Korean Church at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: The purpose of this community of faith is to learn, teach and live the examples of love and service that Christ has shown us. We aim to glorify God through worship, training, fellowship, witness, thanksgiving and service. We provide spiritual and practical support to the Korean and greater Asian community on campus.

name: Korean Student Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The Korean Student Association at Cornell University is a student organization that focuses on enriching the college experience. Our aim is to listen to the needs of students, plan events with the members in mind, and foster a strong sense of community. With over 400 Korean-American and Korean-International student constituent, hosting events year-round, the Cornell KSA is one of the largest and most active student-run, not-for-profit organizations on campus. Each year, the KSA programs a variety of social, cultural, political events – each of which contributes to its main goals: fostering and enhancing relationships among students of Korean descent and promoting the learning and awareness of Korean culture throughout Cornell and the surrounding community.

name: Large Animal Undergraduate Society at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Animals/Wildlife
description: The purpose of Large Animal Undergrad Society at Cornell is to promote students who are interested in large animal medicine. The club aims to provide student with hands-on opportunities to work with large animals and to promote diversity within the field. The club will host networking opportunities with leaders in the industry and support members in entering the field!

name: Last Lecture at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service
description: If you were retiring tomorrow and given the chance to give one last lecture, what would you say? Each semester, we host a Last Lecture event where we invite one faculty member to answer this question in front of the Cornell community. Last Lecture was a beloved Cornell tradition before the pandemic that we have brought back.

name: Latidos at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Through our initiatives, events, and community, our mission is to empower Latinx students (and the broader Cornell community) pursuing careers in medicine. We work to dismantle systemic barriers in health care and cultivate the next generation of physicians and health leaders—leaders whose skills, voices, and compassion will save lives and redefine what equitable medicine looks like.

name: Latino Medical Student Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: LMSA Plus At Cornell aims to foster an environment where Latino students interested in health care can thrive both professionally and personally, and allow them to find a community of like-minded  students. LMSA Plus at Cornell seeks to acknowledge the health needs of the Latino community, as well as to promote the interests and support of those undergraduate premedical students who identify themselves as Latino students of Cornell University through social, cultural, educational, political and other activities. As part of a larger professional national network of The Latino Medical Student Association, LMSA+ promotes the academic, cultural, social, and professional development of its members through community engagement, mentorship, and advocacy

name: Latinx Association of Pre-laws
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, PROF: Law
description: To provide Latinx self-identifying undergraduate students at Cornell with resources to aid them in their preparation for law school.

name: Lavender
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, Student Groups for Student Services
description: The purpose of Lavender shall be to provide a safe and inclusive space for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, questioning, intersex, asexual, etc. women and nonbinary individuals of Cornell University to engage both socially and educationally with one another.

name: Les Femmes de Substance
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, Student Groups for Student Services
description: The purpose of Les Femmes de Substance is to foster community and leadership within the Black female population on Cornell's campus. Through educational experiences and programs, Les Femmes strives to create women of substance, who will make every effort to give back and build up their surrounding communities.

name: Less Than Three A Cappella
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: Less Than Three wants to share an eclectic and diverse musical repertoire with the Cornell community while helping each member to grow as a singer. Less Than Three seeks to promote music for all audiences and performers.

name: Let's Get Ahead at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Let’s Get Ahead empowers more than 700 students nationwide through free, high-quality tutoring, mentorship, and academic enrichment programs. Our mission is to close opportunity gaps in education by connecting dedicated mentors with students who benefit from personalized support. Beyond academics, we lead initiatives that address community needs—such as food drives, clothing donations, and school supply distributions—to ensure students and families have the resources they need to thrive. Through our global initiative in Ghana, we extend our commitment to educational equity abroad by supporting rural schools and clinics with essential resources. Rooted in community and collaboration, we strive to help every student reach their potential and build a brighter future—one student at a time.

name: Lifted at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service
description: We are dedicated community service participants who assist and engage in service projects on Cornell's campus and the Ithaca communities. Our flagship event is Lifted.

name: Line Dancing Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: The purpose of the Line Dancing Club at Cornell shall be to create an inclusive country dance community and contribute to the social dance scene at Cornell through the instruction of line dance choreographies.

name: Lion Dance at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Performing Arts
description: Cornell Lion Dance strives to carry on the tradition of Lion Dancing while enriching the Cornell and Ithaca communities.

name: Litera: Ukrainian Educational Outreach
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Community Service
description: The mission of Litera shall be to provide educational outreach opportunities to elementary, middle, and high school students in Ukraine in the form of virtual group outreach sessions led by Cornell students, faculty, and staff who are volunteer members of Litera.

name: Literary Society at Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media
description: Organized by and for English majors and enthusiasts, the society plans events each semester to inspire interest in the major. Events may include panel discussions with English Department professors, student poetry readings, book club discussions with Cornell authors, pre-performance discussions for theater productions at the Schwartz Center, a mentor program between under- and upper-class English majors and luncheons with visiting writers. The Literary Society is comprised of English enthusiasts of all different areas – from English majors with concentrations spanning literary theory, creative writing, medieval literature and British literature to English minors and students of other disciplines. Anyone with a love for reading is encouraged to join the listserv and attend the society's weekly book club, where students chat in the English Lounge over refreshments.

name: LOKO
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: LOKO is a union among students of all backgrounds that is aimed at promoting Korean music, fine arts, and culture through dance performances.

name: Lunatic Magazine at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media
description: Our purpose is to entertain and delight the Cornell University community with humor, mirth, and satire. We publish a glossy print magazine once a semester with stories, articles, comics, and art. We also run a website where we post content regularly.

name: Lutheran Student Fellowship
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: The purpose of the Fellowship shall be to provide a space for students to serve the Lord and fellow man; to spread the kingdom of God by carrying out an active mission program.

name: Magic the Gathering Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Gaming/Esports, Tabletop Games
description: The Cornell Magic the Gathering Club is a community built around the collectible trading card game Magic: the Gathering, connecting players and hosting tournaments and casual events.

name: Mainland China Students Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: Mainland China Students Association works to provide a network and community for Cornell students who are interested in Mainland Chinese affairs. We hold events to foster cultural enrichment for both MCSA members and the greater Cornell community. Examples include Taste of China, Cultural Show, Chinese New Year Gala, karaoke, movie night, etc. MCSA also strives to hold strong relationships with other organizations on campus with the goal of promoting unity at Cornell. MCSA is committed to bringing the best cultural experience for all those interested.

name: Mapping Society at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Gaming/Esports
description: The purpose of MSC is to grant students opportunities to engage in mapping and related geospatial activities that address challenges at local, national, and global scales. Students will create, analyze, and share open data and learn to use open source software in this process.

name: Marginalia: the Cornell Undergraduate Poetry Review
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media, Poetry
description: Marginalia Review publishes the poetic works of Cornell's undergraduates, regardless of college or major. We hope to foster a community of poets, artists, and literary admirers by producing at least two publications a year and by hosting multiple workshops and readings each semester.

name: Mariachi Regional en Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Performing Arts
description: It is our mission to share our passion for traditional Mariachi music with individuals from any background, and through this music add to Cornell University's increasingly diverse student population.

name: Mastering Unique, Nutritious Culinary Hacks at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, Food/Drink
description: To inspire and empower students to develop lifelong healthy eating and cooking habits by making nutritious, sustainable food accessible, engaging, and fun.

name: Materials Society at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Engineering
description: The Materials Society at Cornell represents the university's undergraduate chapter of The Materials Research Society (MRS), The Materials Information Society (ASM), The Minerals, Metals, and Materials Society (TMS), and American Ceramics Society (ACerS). We partner with Materials Advantage to bring students to professional organizations (ACeRS, TMS, ASM, and AIST) at an affordable price. CMS is a student-run organization devoted to unity of MS&E majors and others interested in the fields of nanotechnology, biomedical engineering, semiconductors, polymers, ceramics, glasses, and metals.

name: Med-In Black Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing
description: We, the aspiring Black pre-health students, in our pursuit of academic excellence and a future in healthcare, do hereby establish the Black Pre-Health Alliance. In recognition of our shared aspirations, unique experiences, and the challenges we face on our journey toward careers in health and medicine, we unite under this banner to forge a community of support, empowerment, and advocacy. We acknowledge the historic underrepresentation of Black individuals across health professions and the urgent need to address disparities in healthcare. We pledge to uphold these principles and to work collaboratively toward a future where Black individuals are represented at all levels of the health field, where healthcare inequities are reduced, and where our collective efforts contribute to a healthier, more just society.

name: Media & Entertainment at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media
description: To educate students who are interested in media about professional skills. To facilitate intercultural communication through hosting entertainment events.

name: Media Guild, Inc
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media, PROF: Business and Management
description: The Cornell Media Guild, Inc. provides students with the opportunity to gain comprehensive media training/experience based on the operation of WVBR 93.5 FM, CornellRadio.net, and Electric Buffalo Records.

name: Medical Ethics & Dilemmas Society
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing
description: The mission of the Medical Ethics and Dilemmas Society (MEDS) is to foster a community of students dedicated to exploring and understanding the complex ethical issues in medicine and healthcare. MEDS aims to promote thoughtful discussion, critical analysis, and collaborative problem-solving to address ethical dilemmas, both historical and contemporary. The society is committed to cultivating ethical leadership, empathy, and a commitment to finding morally sound alternatives to questionable medical practices, preparing its members to navigate the challenges of the medical field with integrity and compassion.

name: Medics in Armenia at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Health/Wellbeing
description: The purpose of Medics in Armenia is to educate and train students interested in and/or pursuing a future in medicine by traveling to Armenia to shadow medical professionals and to volunteer at impoverished communities across Armenia.

name: Mediocre Melodies
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Performing Arts
description: The Mediocre Melodies is a revolutionary a cappella group that is truly the first of its kind. We are, quite frankly, average singers who have always wanted an a cappella experience but don't quite have what it takes to make one of the big ones! We are co-ed and focused on having fun and making friends while also creating some beautiful music along the way. Along with being an a cappella group, we donate all possible proceeds to charity. In short, we are "Bad Singers for a Good Cause".

name: Medium Design Collective
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media, Visual Arts
description: Medium is an interdisciplinary design organization at Cornell University, whose mission is to build an interdisciplinary collective of individuals, as a platform for engaging in dialogue and collaboration about design. Majors from all seven colleges are represented in our collective, which is split into incubates, events, marketing, web, education, and publication. Each year, Medium creates design projects and a publication centered around a theme, and puts on events that showcase different facets of design and workshops that teach design skills. In this way, we hope to spark dialogue through design, linking computer scientists, architects, and everybody in between.

name: MEDLIFE
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: MEDLIFE is a non-profit organization that works in developing countries to improve access to MEDs: Medicine, Education, and Development. Our overarching mission is to help families achieve greater freedom from the constraints of poverty, empowering them to live healthier lives.

name: Melodramatics Theatre Company, Inc.
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: The purpose of The Melodramatics Theatre Company shall be to bring together students and faculty of Cornell University, along with Ithaca College, and the Tompkins County Community to present one entertaining musical theatre production of artistic excellence per semester.

name: Men Of Color in Athletics
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Community Service
description: The mission of Men of Color in Athletics shall be to provide men of color within Cornell Athletics a support network and space to share their experiences. We aspire to foster an atmosphere that encourages the embracing of diverse cultural backgrounds, highlighting the resilience and passion that empower men of color to balance their roles as accomplished students and athletes at the pinnacle of their pursuits.

name: Men of Last Call
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: We are Last Call, an award-winning all-male a cappella group at Cornell University. You can find us singing and performing all across campus from arches to concert halls. If you'd like to check us out, come to one of our semesterly concerts! Or, if you can sing, act, arrange, compose, dance, rap, or beatbox, consider trying out - we're always looking to add to our family. Hope to see you soon!

name: Men's Club Ice Hockey at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: The mission of Cornell Men's Club Ice Hockey is to achieve visible excellence through competition for championships, while promoting wellness and school spirit, through a commitment to developing leaders beyond the game of hockey.

name: Men's Club Lacrosse at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: As with any competitive sports team, we practice and compete against other club lacrosse teams. This includes SUNY Cortland, Binghamton, Syracuse, etc. Although we are definitely competitive, it is also important to us that we maintain an enjoyable environment for everyone involved. We practice about once a week and have a handful of games each semester, with more in the spring season. If you played in HS and miss the sport, don't hesitate to get involved.

name: Men's Club Volleyball at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: Cornell Men's Club Volleyball is dedicated to playing competitive volleyball in a fun, engaging environment. As part of the Eastern Collegiate Volleyball Association (ECVA), we play at least three weekend tournaments per semester, capped off by the national tournament hosted by NCVF. Our conference includes Syracuse, Buffalo, Binghamton, Army, RIT, Cortland, and Brockport. If you love playing volleyball, this is the closest to varsity Cornell has to offer. Contact us or find us playing on the beautiful beaches of north campus. See you at try outs in early September.

name: Men's Club Water Polo at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: The purpose of the men's water polo team is to allow for highly competitive play in a fun environment for all interested students.

name: Men's Fencing Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: Our organization was founded following the disbandment of the Cornell Men's Varsity Fencing team in 1991. We serve as the non-varsity counterpart to the Women's Varsity Team and compete in National and Regional competitions throughout the United States. We hope to spread the sport of fencing on the Cornell Campus and strive to provide an outlet for experienced men fencers to compete against other club and varsity teams throughout the nation. A part of our club makes up the Women's Varsity Practice Squad, who assist the girls in practice and receive coaching from the Women's coaching staff.

name: Men's Rugby Football Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: The purpose of Men’s Rugby Football Club shall be to foster the growth of rugby among Cornell University students through organized competition, skill development, and the promotion of physical fitness and teamwork.

name: Men's Swim Club at Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: The Men's Cornell Club Swim Team is a Cornell club sports team where anyone with prior competitive swimming experience can train for competition with the team. The team will practice weekly and compete in intercollegiate meets throughout the semester in order to gauge personal development and to bond as a team.

name: Mexican Students Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The Mexican Student Association's (MexSA) purpose is to connect students of Mexican descent at Cornell and abroad. By navigating the manifestation of culture, MexSA aims to foster leadership and aid in civic engagement, creating an empowering and supportive community. Deep and familial bonds await for anyone who decides to join MexSA.

name: Middle Eastern Music Ensemble at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Performing Arts
description: MEME at Cornell currently focusses on sharing the intricacy and beauty of Arabic vocal music and instruments with the Cornell and Ithaca community. The group's primary instrumentation will consist of the takht ensemble: oud, nay, qanoun, violin, and riq, darbuka, duff, and the additional string section of viola, cello, and bass.  The music of MEME at Cornell will be largely based around Egypt and the Levant, including Muwashahat, classical songs such as Um Kalthoum, and folk songs or songs from other regions that are compatible with a traditional takht ensemble.

name: Minorities in Agriculture Natural Resources and Related Sciences
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The purpose of MANRRS at Cornell shall be to develop and empower individuals in agriculture, natural resources, and related sciences by nurturing potential, supporting unique journeys, and connecting members to opportunities that inspire leadership and innovation. The goals of this organization are to a) support endeavors that foster and promote the agricultural sciences and related fields in a positive manner. b) initiate and participate in activities and programs that will ensure that broaden involvement in the agricultural sciences and related fields. c) work for the inclusion, achievement, and advancement of all people in the agricultural sciences.

name: Minority Animal Science Students
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, Animals/Wildlife
description: The primary focus of MASS (Minority Animal Science Students) is to support underrepresented minority students in the field of animal science. This organization understands the continuous struggle of minorities pursuing a future in animal studies, including lack of representation in the field. It shall be the goal of MASS to consciously support these students in the animal science division of undergraduate studies at Cornell University and encourage their success.

name: MiXed at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: Mixed at Cornell is a Cornell University organization that aims to create a supportive network for multiethnic, multiracial, multicultural, and multinational individuals - by facilitating dialogue and providing a platform for the members of our mixed community.

name: Mock Trial Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Political/Speech/Debate
description: The Cornell Undergraduate Mock Trial Association is a student-run undergraduate organization that competes against other collegiate mock trial teams in various tournaments throughout the fall and spring semesters. Over the course of the academic year, we work to develop critical thinking, public speaking, legal reasoning, and acting prowess, culminating in numerous trials where we argue a prepared case before a panel of judges. Because of the variety of roles, Cornell's Mock Trial Team is comprised of a wide diversity of members with an array of interests and career aspirations within the legal and non-legal worlds.

name: Moot Court at Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Political/Speech/Debate
description: Moot Court at Cornell University shall be established for the primary purpose of allowing undergraduate students to pursue their interest in constitutional law and legal argumentation. Although Cornell hosts many law-centered organizations, few, if any, serve undergraduate students in their legal pursuits. Whereas organizations such as mock trial focus on performative aspects of argumentation, moot court brings a unique combination of competitive argumentation and exposure to substantive constitutional principles.

name: Movimiento Estudiantil Chican at de Aztlan
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: MECHA provides academic and personal support to students in the organization, enhances the community's awareness of Chicanx culture through educational, cultural, and social programming, and promotes the continued education of Chicanx students. We are working towards a decolonial understanding of the "Chicanx" label. It transcends beyond an identity; it is a philosophy and mindset. "Chicanx" is inclusive of any person of any ethnicity or race. Although MECHA used to cater to the Latinx community, the organization is open to anyone willing to liberate and empower the marginalized. We aim to celebrate our cultures and history but remain cognizant of the facts, stories, and voices that have yet to enter the mainstream conversations around what it means to be Chicanx.

name: Mu Epsilon Delta
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: Professional Fraternity (PFC), PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: Mu Epsilon Delta is a national co-educational, pre-health professional fraternity whose mission is to prepare members to succeed in pre-health careers through the development of scholarship, fraternity, and service. We encourage excellence in health science scholarship through promoting a holistic model of healthcare by fostering cooperation and collaboration between various pre-health disciplines, educations, an professionals

name: Muay Thai Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: Cornell Thai Boxing Club provides members of the Cornell community an opportunity to learn and practice the combat sport of Muay Thai. All levels of interest and experience are welcomed and respected. To participate in controlled contact sparring, it must be sanctioned by the instructor and both participants must sign the Waiver and Release Form.

name: Mundial FC Mens Club Soccer at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: Mundial FC is an organization committed to playing competitive college-level soccer with established players of different backgrounds and playing styles. The team consistently represents Cornell at the Region 1 tournament, and in 2023, won the Regional Championship, making Mundy first out of over 160 teams in the northeast. In 2023, Mundial was ranked 5th in the country., and appeared in the National Championship Tournament for the second year in a row. Mundial values creating a competitive, but more importantly, fun environment, and promoting strong friendships on and off the field.  We compete in the Finger Lakes Division in New York and various tournaments both in and out of state.

name: Music Lovers Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media
description: The purpose of the Music Lovers Club at Cornell is to foster a vibrant community through the shared love of music, offering events and activities that explore diverse genres and deepen musical knowledge. Our mission is to create an inclusive environment wherein members can discover new music, celebrate their favorites, and engage with the broader musical community.

name: Music Production at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media
description: We strive to build a community of people interested in all aspects of music production. Regardless of experience, we hope to allow polish every interest in music into concrete growth.

name: Muslim Educational and Cultural Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: Provide educational, cultural and religious services to the Cornell community and its surrounding communities in order to promote an Islamic environment and an awareness of Islam.

name: Muslim Professional Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: The mission of Muslim Professional Association (MPA) is to foster the development of socially-aware leaders within Cornell University and beyond, with a focus on the Muslim community. MPA aims to build professional skills and prepare members for successful careers in industry or postgraduate programs through engagement with complex issues, leadership opportunities, and strategic development.

name: Mutual Investment Club of Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: The Mutual Investment Club of Cornell (MICC) is the largest undergraduate student-run investment club at Cornell University, currently with approximately $115,000 in assets. Our core business is managing an internationally diversified portfolio of equity and fixed income securities. Our mission is to bring asset management capabilities into the hands of students with the goals of promoting education, performance, and industry exposure to students of all levels.

name: Myanmar Students Association at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: This organization aims to promote awareness of Myanmar, its culture on the Cornell Campus and the Ithaca Tompkins community, and to have space for a community of students with ties to, or interests in Myanmar.

name: National Alliance on Mental Illness at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Health/Wellbeing, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Provide support to families, relatives and friends of people diagnosed with mental health conditions; Educate about serious mental illnesses; and advocate for families impacted by mental illness.

name: National Association of Anorexia and Associated Disorders Chapter at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing
description: As a long-time volunteer with ANAD and someone who has personally experienced the challenges of eating disorders, I am passionate about bringing the ANAD School Ambassador Program to Cornell.In alignment with ANAD’s mission and core values, Cornell ASAP (Awareness, Support, and Prevention) will foster an open, inclusive community that promotes self-care, body acceptance, and overall wellbeing. We believe in the power of connection, compassion, and long-term community relationships as key elements of healing and awareness. Our group will collaborate closely with ANAD to ensure that all communication, programming, and educational materials use appropriate and recovery-supportive language. While we are an awareness-based organization and not a direct peer support group, we are committed to connecting any student who reaches out with body image or eating concerns to professional on-campus resources or to ANAD’s national peer support network. Through education, empathy, and advocacy, Cornell ASAP aims to create a campus culture that normalizes conversations about eating disorders and encourages help-seeking without stigma. It's important to recognize that Cornell currently has no student group dedicated to raising awareness and this gap leaves many students without a visible, supportive space to learn about prevention, recovery, and self-compassion. By establishing a chapter of ANAD’s School Ambassador Program at Cornell, we can create a community centered on education, awareness, and connection. The Cornell Body Positive Club has not been active for a few years, leaving a gap in the community.

name: NatureRX
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, Sustainability/Environmental
description: Nature Rx is built on the premise that time spent in nature is therapeutic, can supplement clinical interventions, and contributes to overall mental health and well-being. We work to help students of all disciplines and levels improve their cognitive ability, lessen symptoms of anxiety, and reduce stress through interactive events in nature. We welcome our members to delve into their personal background, love for the great outdoors, inner wellness and an interest in improving the health of their community as a part of NatureRx.

name: Neo-Soul Ensemble
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: Neo-Soul an instrumental group that encourages musicianship and creativity in an effort to craft meaningful and innovative musical performances.

name: Nepalese Student Association at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The Nepalese Student Association at Cornell (NSAC) is dedicated to fostering a welcoming and inclusive community for Nepalese and Nepalese American students. Our mission is to create a vibrant and supportive environment where individuals from Nepal and of Nepalese descent can come together, celebrate their cultural heritage, and navigate their academic journeys effectively in a foreign land.

name: Network of Enlightened Women - Cornell University Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Political/Speech/Debate
description: The mission of NeW is to foster the education and leadership skills of university women. NeW is also devoted to expanding the intellectual diversity on college campuses. NeW members meet regularly to discuss the opportunities and challenges facing women today, as well as current political issues.

name: NeuroNerds
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The mission of NeuroNerds is to design, build, revise, and share neuroscience and psychology lessons with local youth in the Central New York region. In working towards these goals, NeuroNerds aims to address educational inequities within the STEM education available to primary and secondary school students in the Central New York region.

name: Nigerian Students Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The purpose of the Nigerian Students Association is to foster cultural unity and understanding among the Nigerian community at Cornell. We hope to provide a forum that will celebrate the diversity embodied in Nigeria through cultural events, educational seminars, and community outreach programs, as well as sharing the culture not only with Nigerian students, but with the Cornell community at large.

name: Nordic Ski Racing at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: The purpose of Nordic Ski Racing at Cornell is to provide an opportunity for Cornell students to compete in the sport of Nordic (cross-country) skiing. We also provide instruction and equipment for those students who do not know how to Nordic ski to come learn how to ski.

name: North African Student Association at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The purpose of the North African Student Association shall be to create a supportive community for students of North African heritage and those interested in the region. Our mission is to celebrate and share the diverse cultures, histories, and languages of North Africa, while fostering dialogue, representation, and cross-cultural understanding on campus.

name: Nothing But Treble
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: We hope to bring joy to the Cornell and Ithaca community through music and song. Our organization brings undergraduate women together who like to sing and perform. We hold own concerts each semester and perform at many other events and shows throughout the year.

name: On Tap Dance Troupe
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Performing Arts
description: On Tap Dance Troupe is Cornell's only all-tap dancing troupe. This group of fun-loving tappers performs at shows both on and off campus. Every spring, On Tap hosts its own spring show, featuring original student choreography.

name: Open Orchestra at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: To create a non-competitive, less demanding community for Cornell students who play string instruments, with a common performance goal.

name: Optica Cornell Student Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Engineering, PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: The purpose of this organization is to further the commitment to optics research put forth by the Optica Foundation and create a community for those in both academia and industry here at Cornell.

name: Organization for Afghan Students
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The purpose of the Organization for Afghan Students is to create a space for members of the Cornell community of Afghan origin and those interested in Afghanistan's culture to learn about and celebrate this culture together.

name: Orthodox Christian Fellowship
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: The Orthodox Christian Fellowship (OCF) is the official collegiate campus ministry program under the Assembly of Canonical Orthodox Bishops of North and Central America.  Our mission is to support fellowships on college campuses, whose members experience and witness to the Orthodox Christian Church through community life, prayer, service to others and study of the Faith.

name: Outing Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Outdoor Experience, Sustainability/Environmental
description: Since 1928, Cornell Outing Club has been helping Cornellians get outside and enjoy the outdoors. Whether you're interested in learning a new activity, developing your outdoors skills, or meeting other people who share your passion for outdoor adventure, there's a place in the Cornell Outing Club for you.

name: Pakistani Students Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, Student Groups for Student Services
description: Our student organization is dedicated to amplifying the voices of Pakistani students at Cornell and beyond. We're passionate about fostering unity among the youth of the Subcontinent and challenging prevailing stereotypes, along with creating a safe and welcoming space for Pakistani students to meet one another.

name: Pan-African Muslim Student Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: Cornell PAMSA is Cornell University's Black Muslim Student Organization dedicated to creating a community for Black Muslims on campus. To create this community, PAMSA will provide a space for the education and discussion of the cultural, political, and social landscape of the Muslim and Black Diaspora convergence.

name: Pan-African Students Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The Pan-African Students Association (PASA) aspires to foster a strong solidarity among pan-African people, scholars and all those interested in African culture and developmental issues. PASA hopes to create awareness of the rich cultural diversity, history and present state of Africa through its programs and events and in collaborations with other groups and institutions.

name: Pandora Dance Troupe
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Performing Arts
description: A student-led, student-choreographed dance troupe, Pandora specializes in contemporary, ballet, modern, jazz, lyrical and hip hop. Our troupe puts together a showcase every fall, and participates in a number of guest performances throughout the year. Every spring, Pandora hosts "Spring into Motion" and invites several campus organizations to join them in performing at this annual benefit concert.

name: Pangea Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Sustainability/Environmental
description: The mission of the PCC shall be to disseminate knowledge related to Earth and atmospheric sciences, such as, but not limited to, the structure and history of the Earth, as well as to explore local geological phenomena that has shaped, and continues to shape, Ithaca and the greater Finger Lakes region through interactive and hands-on field trips.

name: Pants Improv Comedy
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: To teach and perform improvisational comedy and to encourage and celebrate enthusiasm for improv in the Cornell and Ithaca community.

name: Parkinson's Pals
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Our mission is to pair Parkinson's patients with an undergraduate student to alleviate the social isolation and depression felt amongst Parkinson's patients. It is noted that nearly 55% of Parkinson's patients experience some form of depression. By fostering intergenerational connections, we hope to provide a new face and friend for patients.

name: Peace Action Chapter at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Sustainability/Environmental
description: To practice different aspects of peace and understanding among a diverse group of students as it relates to nuclear disarmament and environmental impacts.

name: Perfect Match
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Software/Coding/Programming, Student Groups for Student Services
description: The purpose of the organization is to develop a matching algorithm for Cornell students to meet each other based on interests and similarities. The matching service will commence annually every February followed by a meet and greet event.

name: Perfect Pair Cornell Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing
description: Perfect Pair fosters one-on-one, intergenerational connections between older adults and college students. We strive to reinforce a mutual sense of community and purpose for our pairs: a goal that underlies our efforts to combat loneliness and improve overall health and wellbeing. We achieve this by ensuring that our pair connections are personalized: based on shared background and interests. Simultaneously, we encourage pairs to re-engage with their passions by offering individualized and accessible programming. We hope for older adults and students to feel that their life perspective and quality of life have been meaningfully enhanced by their experience in our program.

name: PERIOD at CORNELL
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: We are a group of young activists united by the belief that menstrual care is a basic right. Our mission is to celebrate periods and provide products to those in need. Service, education, and advocacy are the three pillars of our organization.

name: Persian Students Organization
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The Persian Students Organization (PSO) aims to build a community for Persian undergraduate students at Cornell by hosting events promoting Persian culture, engaging in international philanthropic activities, and fostering learning about Iran and the Iranian people on campus. The PSO shall be free and open to everyone, regardless of race, gender, ethnicity, beliefs, etc. The PSO is not religiously or politically affiliated.

name: Phenomenon Step Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: Phenomenon Step Team's purpose is to spread the culture and history of stepping throughout the Cornell campus. This tradition dates back to South African Gumboot dance and lives through stepping, especially in the Black community, as a powerful form of expression, unity, and history.

name: Phi Alpha Delta Pre-Law Fraternity
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: Professional Fraternity (PFC), PROF: Law
description: Phi Alpha Delta Law Fraternity (PAD) was founded on November 4, 1897. Since then, the organization's network has grown to make it the largest organization of lawyers and pre-law students in the world: 1 in 6 lawyers in the United States is a card-carrying member of PAD The Cornell pre-law chapter of Phi Alpha Delta is the largest pre-law organization at Cornell University. Our chapter has over 60 members and an extensive alumni network. Our alumni are law students at Harvard, Stanford, NYU, UPenn, Cornell, among others. Phi Alpha Delta Law Fraternity, International is a professional law fraternity advancing integrity, compassion and courage through service to the student, the school, the profession and the community. We are the pre-eminent law fraternity promoting the bonds of fraternalism and we are the leader in the development and advancement of professional ideals.

name: Phi Chi Theta
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, AFFILIATION: Professional Fraternity (PFC), PROF: Business and Management
description: "To promote the cause of higher business education and training for all individuals, to foster high ideals for everyone pursuing a career in business; to encourage fraternity and cooperation among people preparing for such careers; and to stimulate the spirit of sacrifice and unselfish devotion to the attainment of such ends."

name: Phi Delta Epsilon International Medical Fraternity
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, AFFILIATION: Professional Fraternity (PFC), PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: Phi Delta Epsilon International Medical Fraternity creates physicians of integrity with a life-long commitment to our guiding principles of philanthropy, deity, and education through fellowship, service, mentoring, and formal training in leadership, science, and ethics.

name: Phi Gamma Nu Professional Business Fraternity
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: Professional Fraternity (PFC), PROF: Business and Management
description: Phi Gamma Nu at Cornell proudly upholds Three National Pillars which represent the underlying ideals of the fraternity. As such, events and activities organized by Phi Gamma Nu brothers work to fulfill these goals in practice. Through Professionalism, Phi Gamma Nu at Cornell seeks to constantly spread interest in the business field throughout college campuses. To this end, the National Board promotes the chapters' organization of creative professional events including networking workshops and speaker events. Through Philanthropy, Phi Gamma Nu chapters are able to build strong bonds with their respective communities as well. As the fraternity's brothers believe in civic responsibility, chapters nationwide organize and participate in community outreach events like fundraisers and benefit walks/runs. Through Community, Phi Gamma Nu chapters believe in upholding the interest of our Alma Maters through the encouragement of high scholarship, participation in school activities, and awareness of important issues and current events on and around campus. By executing these Three National Pillars, Phi Gamma Nu chapters advance in the pursuit of its goals as a premier business fraternity. We believe that by fostering professionalism, service, and community, we can develop a group of PGN brothers well prepared for future endeavors.

name: Phi Sigma Pi National Honors Fraternity- Beta Nu Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service
description: We consecrate ourselves to a life of social service with the goal of improving humanity through our principles: Scholarship, Leadership, and Fellowship.

name: Phoenix Society at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Engineering, Visual Arts
description: Reimagine, redesign, and build anew a phoenix for Dragon Day in an inclusive learning environment to build skills, gain knowledge and develop teamwork. This will be a yearlong effort starting in the fall semester each year.

name: Pi Lambda Sigma
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: Professional Fraternity (PFC), PROF: Law, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Pi Lambda Sigma (POLIS, for short) aims to promote, deepen, and advance the interests of students passionate about pursuing careers in or related to government, politics, and policy. A "pre-government student" is defined as any student looking to be employed by a government (at any level or location) or contract for, advocate, or lobby the government as the principal focus of their career.

name: Pi Sigma Epsilon
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: Professional Fraternity (PFC), PROF: Business and Management
description: The Pi Sigma Epsilon Zeta Alpha chapter was founded in 2011 by Cornell students who wanted to form a business fraternity focused on a wide range of business fields. This business fraternity has a national focus on sales and marketing but we emphasize a diversity of interests within business. This has enabled us to attract students with a wide range of career goals and interests, thus expanding our campus and alumni networks. Our alumni have played a major role in the founding and growth of PSE, and thus have a very close tie to the roots of our fraternity. Our brothers are constantly reaching out to alum for advice on internships, career searches, and resume critiques. Our fraternity is designed to educate its members about various fields of business through a rigorous education process as well as a number of brotherhood-wide events during the year. Recruiters come and speak exclusively to our brotherhood and provide personal opportunities and advice. Additionally, alumni and industry professionals host events in which they come to speak exclusively with us. We focus on offering our members private assistance for interviews, resume, and job seeking strategies.

name: Piano Society at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Performing Arts
description: The Piano Society at Cornell provides a community for pianists and piano fans in the Cornell community of all ages, abilities, and interests. We provide member-to-member lessons to help beginners sharpen their skills and to help intermediate students keep up with their practicing and performing. We hold formal and informal concerts throughout the year. We host various social events to foster a community of people on campus who love piano. We collaborate with other organizations on campus who are looking for pianists. We connect our members with resources on campus including university lessons, master classes, performance opportunities, visiting musicians, and more.

name: Planned Parenthood Generation Action
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Planned Parenthood Generation Action works with Planned Parenthood of Greater New York to educate students on sexual health and engage them on the issues that threaten their access to reproductive health care.  We aim to make Cornell a safer, healthier, and more informed community.

name: Pole Posse
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Performing Arts
description: This organization works to provide instruction in pole dancing. Although pole dancing is increasingly seen as a sport or fitness routine, we aim to prioritize its origins in our practice of it. Sex workers and other workers in ''informal" or "alternative" professions were practicing and cultivating pole dancing long before it become more mainstream. We believe that the active attempt to verbally cleanse pole dancing by separating it from its origins in sex work enacts violence upon this marginalized group. As a club, we refuse to indulge in this cleansing by exclusively invoking pole dancing as a fitness regimen which developed in a vacuum rather than one that came and comes from a systemically oppressed group and culture. We are committed to honoring this group and expressing the multitudes that exist within the craft of pole dancing while working in active opposition to individuals and systems that seek to harm this group.

name: Political Strategy Group at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Political Strategy Group at Cornell provides pro-bono analysis and strategic advisory to political campaigns and activist organizations, while instilling the value of civic engagement in the next generation of leaders.

name: Pre-Dental Society at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: Our mission is to foster a community at Cornell for all students who are curious or seriously considering a profession in dentistry.

name: Pre-Physician Assistant Association at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: The mission of PPAAC is to cultivate an engaging and intentional community among students at Cornell who are interested and/or actively pursuing a career as a physician assistant (PA). PPAAC empowers members to advance their academic and professional path in the medical field with the goal of improving the quality and accessibility of healthcare.

name: Prison Reform and Education Project (PREP)
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service
description: To advocate on behalf of legislative reform, educate students on relevant issues, and integrate existing organizations to work for prison reform in the United States.

name: Pro-Yos
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Performing Arts
description: The purpose of the Pro-Yos shall be to promote a caring and inclusive community of members dedicated to learning and performing the diabolo, also known as the Chinese yoyo. The Pro-Yos shall promote public awareness of diabolo and engage the Cornell community and the surrounding Ithaca area community, through regular performances during the course of each academic year at events and showcases.

name: Professional Development of Women at Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: PDOW is an all-female-led organization with the purpose of equipping women on campus with valuable personal finance knowledge and skills, like budgeting and investing, that go beyond the classroom setting. PDOW also introduces members to various career paths within the business world, which they can pursue upon graduating from Cornell, and helps prepare member for the job interview and application process.

name: Project Generations
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service
description: Project Generations aims to bridge the gap between the student and elderly population by matching students to senior citizens in the Ithaca community. Through a weekly, one-on-one volunteer visit, Project Generations allows students to build close friendships with their seniors, who may otherwise have not had a friendly visitor to spend time with.

name: Project Hope at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Community Service
description: To promote awareness and to improve the quality of education for children facing poverty in rural areas of China and Hong Kong.

name: Project Level The Field Cornell Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The purpose of Project Level The Field shall be to empower students to reach their full academic potential by providing high-quality resources free of charge. Project Level The Field believe that every individual, regardless of their background or financial situation, should have access to the tools and information needed to excel in their educational journey. Project Level The Field Cornell Chapter shall reflect the same mission as Project Level The Field, Inc.

name: Project Smile Global Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Health/Wellbeing, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, Student Groups for Student Services
description: Project Smile Global is a national student-led 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to fighting oral health disparities worldwide. Our mission is to provide access to oral healthcare for underprivileged communities around the globe. We are a team of dedicated volunteers who believe that everyone deserves a healthy smile. We work towards this goal by organizing dental events, providing basic oral care education, and advocating for better oral health policies at the local and national levels. Join us in restoring confidence through healthier smiles. Starting a PSG chapter at Cornell would mean providing access to oral healthcare to the local Ithaca community.

name: Protestant Cooperative Ministry at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: PCM is an ecumenical Christian campus ministry program supported by the Presbyterian Church (USA), the United Methodist Church, the United Church of Christ and the American Baptist Church. We hold Sunday services in the Chapel in Anabel Taylor Hall at 11 AM. In addition to Sunday services, PCM has also organized a pick-up choir, service trips, Sunday discussions, and participation in community service and events.

name: Psi Chi the International Honors Society in Psychology
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: Psi Chi is an international honor society whose purpose shall be to encourage, stimulate, and maintain excellence in scholarship of the individual members in all fields, particularly in psychology, and to advance the science of psychology.

name: Puerto Rican Student Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The Puerto Rican Student Association was created with the purpose of fostering a sense of community among Puerto Rican undergraduate and graduate students at Cornell University. PRSA coordinates and sponsors culturally and politically educational activities regarding Puerto Rican issues and promotes and develops programs that will seek the involvement of Puerto Rican students and the greater Latino community at Cornell. PRSA strives to foster a support network of Puerto Rican alumni, thereby uplifting the Puerto Rican community at Cornell and throughout future endeavors.

name: PulseGuard at Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Health/Wellbeing
description: To educate members of the Cornell community around the use of compressions-only CPR. PulseGuard will maintain communication with CUEMS on this type of education sharing.

name: Pun Intended Stand-Up Comedy Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: Pun Intended is a club for students interested in learning more about, as well as performing, stand-up comedy. We focus on understanding the elements of a successful comedian through watching and discussing sets of both established and amateur comedians, and from there we work on practicing content development and delivery through further discussion and performance within and outside of the club.

name: Puppet Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts, Visual Arts
description: To provide a creative, low-stress space for Cornell students to create and perform with puppets.

name: qSTEM
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, Student Groups for Student Services
description: The mission of qSTEM is to promote the social and professional development of LGBTQ+ students of Cornell University who are interested in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics) fields.

name: Quant Fund at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management, PROF: Software/Coding/Programming
description: The purpose of Quant Fund at Cornell is to foster a community of innovators to explore cutting edge developments in quantitative finance. The increasingly technologically complex nature of financial markets necessitates innovation upon traditional investing approaches. By fully utilizing the latest technology, the quant approach makes financial analysis less subjective and more precise.

name: Quantum Computing Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Engineering, PROF: Software/Coding/Programming
description: The Quantum Computing Association at Cornell (Cornell QCA) aims to inspire interest in Quantum Information Science and equip students with the background and skills necessary to participate in the field. We teach an introductory lecture series, host events, and pursue research with project members, allowing students of all experience levels to learn and contribute to the rapidly growing quantum computing industry.

name: Queery
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Software/Coding/Programming, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Queery is focused on empowering queer individuals, questioning individuals and their allies interested in the tech field at Cornell.

name: Quill & Dagger
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media
description: Quill & Dagger is a senior honor society at Cornell University that recognizes undergraduate students for leadership, character, and service.

name: Quisqueya: Dominican Students' Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Community Service
description: Quisqueya—The Dominican Students Association—was founded at Cornell University in 1995 with the intention of spreading awareness concerning the Dominican experience and culture.

name: Quiz Bowl Club, Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Gaming/Esports
description: The Quiz Bowl Club provides an enjoyable, supplementary learning experience for Cornellians through the collective playing of quizbowl questions. We are primarily recreational, though the game is inherently competitive.
