description: The purpose of the Voices of Equity Cornell Chapter shall be to advocate for health equity of the Ithaca and greater-Ithaca area community through dismantling systemic barriers that inhibit an individual's access to quality healthcare. This will be done through educating members, inspiring individuals to prioritize our issue, and empowering individuals to act in order to alleviate health inequities.

name: Volunteers Around the World Veterinary Outreach
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Animals/Wildlife
description: Veterinary Outreach provides interns with an opportunity to work first hand with experienced local veterinarians. Interns will fund raise for medications and supplies prior to the trip abroad. While in country, interns will assist the veterinarians with performing physical exams, giving vaccines, performing surgeries, deworming animals and assessing general health and well-being. All intern activities are under the direct supervision of a licensed veterinarian.  This is an intensive internship, valuable to future veterinarians, veterinary technicians and other future healthcare providers as well as those interested in seeing what it is like to work in a developing country. The internship is focused on giving interns a variety of experiences, deepening their understanding of the veterinary field, and broadening their global view.

name: WebDev
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Software/Coding/Programming
description: Cornell Webdev is an inclusive software club for self-driven web designers, developers, and enthusiasts! Learn more at: www.cornellwebdev.com

name: Weill-Ithaca Network
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing
description: Our mission is to provide a gateway for Cornell pre-medical undergraduates to gain exposure to the medical field by pairing students with a Weill Cornell medical student mentor and organizing events that include trips to the Weill Cornell campus in NYC. The broader vision of WIN is to bridge the geographical divide between the two campuses, thereby facilitating greater intercampus dialogue and collaboration at the student level. Distance should not become a significant obstacle for students' academic and professional growth. We hope to expand to include Physicians Assistants and PhD mentorship programs with Weill Cornell in the future.

name: Western Equestrian Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Animals/Wildlife
description: Our purpose is to further the equestrian skills of our members, specifically related to the Western riding discipline. We promote proper horse handling and riding techniques to make the experience valuable to both the horse and the rider, as well as compete regionally to further individual and team standing.

name: Whistling Shrimp Improv Comedy Troupe
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: To learn, practice, and perform the basic principles of improv comedy.

name: Wild Roses Ultimate Frisbee
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: The Cornell Wild Roses is a competitive women and gender queer college-level ultimate frisbee team registered with USA Ultimate. We practice 3 times a week and go to 4-5 tournaments per semester. Frisbee is a welcoming community where you're encouraged to be kind, work hard, and laugh harder. We are a tight knit group that genuinely loves spending time together and are committed to helping each other grow.

name: Women in Chemistry
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: To create an environment where women feel comfortable discussing chemistry and can support their peers in their studies.

name: Women in Poker Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Tabletop Games
description: The purpose of Women in Poker is to provide all-female poker strategy lessons and playing opportunities in an inclusive and empowering environment in the traditionally male-dominated space. Our main goal is to give female students who might be intimidated or too busy to otherwise learn how to play poker a first-experience and refer those looking to continue playing regularly to Cornell Poker Club for additional lessons and playing opportunities.

name: Women Leaders of Color
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: Our mission is to empower and provide resources to women of color who aspire to step into leadership positions in their community, workplace, and beyond. Through mentorship programs, inspirational speaking seminars, workshops, and events, WLC aims to enable opportunities and promote leadership and professional development among women of color in the Cornell community.

name: Women of Color Athletics
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Health/Wellbeing
description: To provide women of color within Cornell Athletics a support network and space to share their experiences. We seek to stimulate the acceptance of cultural identities and celebrate the strength, brains and uniqueness that empowers women of color in their pursuit of being both a successful student and athlete at the highest level.

name: Women of MENA
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media
description: Women of MENA is a digital publication at the intersection of culture and gender studies. Our platform serves as a space to unpack the gender dynamics of the Middle East and North Africa region and share women's stories. Our focus on gender is rooted in inclusivity for people of all gender identities.

name: Women on Wall Street at Cornell Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: The mission of Women on Wall Street is to build an inclusive, transparent, and lifelong community for undergraduate women interested in finance, removing barriers to recruiting, sharing resources openly, and developing the technical and networking skills needed to thrive. This organization has the ability for members to connect with women at other universities as there are many other chapters of Women on Wall Street, including University of California, Berkeley and University of Florida.

name: Women's Club Basketball at Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: The purpose of our organization is to provide women basketball players in the Cornell community to opportunity to play fun, yet competitive basketball.

name: Women's Club Lacrosse at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: Advance skills and knowledge of lacrosse.

name: Women's Club Soccer at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: The purpose of the Cornell Women's Club Soccer team is to provide the campus with the highest level of competitive soccer possible, outside of the Varsity program.

name: Women's Club Softball at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: We provide an opportunity for competitive fast-pitch softball without the time commitment of varsity sports. Our mission is to create a welcoming and friendly, yet competitive environment for players who love being part of a team and want the flexibility to be involved in multiple on-campus activities.

name: Women's Club Volleyball at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: We look to provide a way for girls to keep playing volleyball competitively. We practice twice a week and travel to tournaments on weekends.

name: Women's Club Water Polo at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: We, the Cornell Women's Water Polo Club, believe that students with similar interests in playing and competing in water polo should come together to share their abilities to practice and play as a team in a competitive and fun setting. We believe that this serves to enhance the educational and athletic experience within the university environment. Therefore, we do hereby state as our purpose: to actively culture and represent the undergraduate and graduate population of Cornell University with a strong interest in playing competitive Water Polo.

name: Women's Freestyle Wrestling Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: Our mission is to provide an opportunity for women at Cornell to practice and learn freestyle wrestling. The main style of wrestling taught in the U.S. is folkstyle, but this style is only competitive in U.S. high school boys' and college men's wrestling. Providing freestyle experience will afford greater opportunities for women seeking competition experience, as freestyle wrestling is for women at all levels of competition, from local open tournaments to the international level. We believe that freestyle wrestling can be a highly empowering and liberating activity for women.

name: Women's Higher Education Now
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Sustainability/Environmental
description: Women's Higher Education Now (WHEN) is a student organization that explores the intersectionality of issues related to gender equality, sustainable development, and equitable education on the global stage. WHEN is affiliated with and fundraises for the Asian University for Women, an international university located in Chittagong, Bangladesh that provides higher education to women from underserved communities in Asia.

name: Women's Ice Hockey Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: To enjoy the sport of ice hockey, learn and improve skills, and create a successful team.

name: Women's Leadership Initiative at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The Cornell Women's Leadership Initiative is an undergraduate organization dedicated to empowering and supporting the next generation of women leaders at Cornell University. Our mission is to foster a culture that uplifts and inspires women in their leadership pursuits, both on campus and beyond.

name: Women's Rugby at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: The Cornell Women's Rugby Club exists to foster rugby competition and camaraderie on campus and across the country.

name: Women's Swim Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: The Women's Cornell Club Swim Team is a Cornell club sports team where any prior competitive swimmers can continue to train for competition and attend meets with a team. The Women's team will practice weekly and work together in an inclusive environment, representing Cornell, improving as a swimmer and bonding as a team.

name: Women's Ultimate Frisbee, Cornell Thorny Roses
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: The Cornell Thorny Roses is a competitive college-level ultimate frisbee team registered with USA Ultimate. We travel to tournaments in the northeast area, and occasionally go south for tournaments. We practice 3-4 times a week and go to 4-5 tournaments per semester. Thorny is a tightly knit group of people who have fun together!

name: Wushu Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Performing Arts
description: We are dedicated to promoting, practicing and performing Wushu, a sport comprising various styles of Chinese martial arts.

name: Young Democratic Socialists of America Cornell Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Political/Speech/Debate
description: Our mission is to educate and organize students to aid in a principled movement for social justice. Within and throughout this struggle, we articulate and defend the idea that true human liberation is impossible under capitalism. We seek social change which extends democracy into all aspects of life -- social, political and economic. This is the struggle for democratic socialism. Our vision of socialism is profoundly democratic, feminist, and anti-racist.

name: Young Forwardists at Cornell Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Political/Speech/Debate
description: Young Forwadists are dedicated to engaging, mobilizing, and empowering individuals on campus. Our Mission is to build a United States where partisan tensions are minimized and good governance thrives. We believe that youth will bring this change—we just need to make our voices heard. The Young Forwardists will fix the country by fighting for change through high school, college, and community chapters across the nation. We're changing the country through three commitments: Opportunity, The Forward Process, and Empowerment. Ultimately, the Young Forwardists aims to bring greater awareness of the Forward Party, it's mission, and inspire other students to join the movement.

name: Zambia Community Education Initiative
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service
description: The Zambia Community Education Initiative (ZCEI) is a student organization at Cornell University that aims to develop sustainable secondary education in Zambia by working with local communities to make education accessible to all. The ZCEI is currently working with the Chisekesi community in Southern Providence to fund the building of a secondary school. The inhabitants of rural Chisekesi have no high school, despite the presence of eight basic schools. The nearest high school is over 20km away and costs 600 dollars a year. The distance and cost are largely responsible for the high drop-out rate for ninth graders, leading to high illiteracy rates. For those who do not drop out, the long distances make children (especially female children) vulnerable to assault, sexual harassment and rape. The ZCEI helps to raise money for education opportunities in Chisekesi, collaborates closely with community leaders in Zambia and has taken annual summer trips to the community.

name: Zoo, Exotics, & Wildlife Medicine at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Animals/Wildlife
description: The purpose of Zoo, Exotics, & Wildlife Medicine at Cornell shall be to bring together students interested in veterinary care for zoo, exotic, and wildlife species. We aim to build a supportive community, share knowledge, create hands-on learning opportunities, and make experiences in these fields more accessible to pre-veterinary students.
